>     required, condition = binding['required_slots'], binding['condition']
>     require(all((r['selection'], r['route']) in ROUTES and
>                 (r['kind'] == 'required' and r['obligation_id'] in required or
>                  r['kind'] == 'conditional' and r['obligation_id'] == condition['obligation_id']) for r in rows),
>             'Huff0 specialist ledger scope differs')
>     selected = {p for r in rows if r['kind'] == 'required' for p in required[r['obligation_id']]}
>     if bmi2.KEY in binding and any(r['kind'] == 'conditional' for r in rows):
>         selected.update(condition['slots'])
>     return sorted(selected)
>
>
> def ledger_products(binding, evidence):
>     return [{'entry_kind': 'specialized_product', 'selection': 29, 'route': binding['slots'][p]['method'], **row}
>             for p, row in evidence['fixtures'].items()]
>
>
> def obligation(binding, row, products):
>     conditional = row['kind'] == 'conditional'
>     if conditional and bmi2.KEY not in binding:
>         return {'status': 'not_run', 'reason': 'no recipe-matched portable Huff0 build bound to this plan', 'evidence': None}
>     members = binding['condition']['slots'] if conditional else binding['required_slots'][row['obligation_id']]
>     proof = {'driver': binding['driver'], 'fixture_slots': members}
>     bad = [p for p in members if products[p]['status'] !=
>            ('expected_rejection' if binding['slots'][p]['expected_status'] else 'verified')]
>     if bad:
>         return {'status': 'failed', 'reason': 'failed Huff0 products: ' + ', '.join(bad), 'evidence': proof}
>     if conditional:
>         try:
>             evidence = native.condition_evidence([products[p] for p in members])
>         except ContractError as exc:
>             return {'status': 'failed', 'reason': str(exc), 'evidence': proof}
>         return {'status': 'verified' if evidence['cpu_bmi2_available'] else 'hardware_pending',
>                 'reason': evidence['reason'], 'evidence': {**proof, 'runtime_comparison': evidence}}
>     return {'status': 'verified', 'reason': '', 'evidence': proof}
>
>
> def run_specialized(root, run, binding, rows, append):
>     selected = scope(binding, rows)
>     folder = run / FOLDER
>     folder.mkdir()
>     fixtures, _ = huff0_inputs(root, compare_bmi2=bmi2.KEY in binding)
>     require(binding['slots'] == {p: slot for p, (slot, _) in fixtures.items()}, 'Huff0 specialist input drifted')
>     products = {}
>     try:
>         require(launcher_lock() == binding['launchers'], 'Huff0 specialist isolation launchers drifted')
>         stage_recovery(root, folder, binding['decoder'])
>         if bmi2.KEY in binding:
>             stage_recovery(root, folder, binding[bmi2.KEY]['decoder'], directory=bmi2.DIRECTORY)
>     except (ContractError, OSError) as exc:
>         for row in rows:
>             row.update(status='dependency_failed', reason=str(exc))
>     else:
>         for k in ('logs', 'products', 'controls'):
>             (folder / k).mkdir()
>         for p in selected:
>             slot, raw = fixtures[p]
>             products[p] = native.run_slot(folder, binding, slot, raw, lambda: False)
>         for row in ledger_products(binding, {'fixtures': products}):
>             append(row)
>         for row in rows:
>             row.update(obligation(binding, row, products))
>     return {'driver': binding['driver'], 'fixtures': products, 'files': _files(folder),
>             'statuses': dict(Counter(p['status'] for p in products.values()))}
>
>
> def audit_specialized(run, binding, rows, evidence, *, replay=False):
>     folder = run / FOLDER
>     products, files = evidence['fixtures'], evidence['files']
>     decoders = {DIRECTORY: binding['decoder']}
>     if bmi2.KEY in binding:
>         decoders[bmi2.DIRECTORY] = binding[bmi2.KEY]['decoder']
>     closure = {f'{directory}/{k}': {'path': f'{directory}/{k}', 'bytes': v['bytes'], 'sha256': v['sha256']}
>                for directory, decoder in decoders.items() for k, v in decoder['files'].items()}
>     require(evidence['driver'] == binding['driver'] and list(products) == scope(binding, rows) and files == _files(folder) and

>     if replay:
>         require(launcher_lock() == binding['launchers'], 'Huff0 specialist replay launchers drifted')

>     for p, product in products.items():

>         if replay and passed and product['status'] == 'verified':
>             restored.append(native.restore_slot(folder, binding, slot, product))
>     require(allowed == files.keys(), 'Huff0 specialist evidence contains undeclared assets')
>     for row in rows:
>         require(all(row[k] == v for k, v in obligation(binding, row, products).items()), 'Huff0 obligation verdict differs')
>     return {'statuses': evidence['statuses'], 'obligation_statuses': dict(Counter(r['status'] for r in rows)),

> #!/usr/bin/env python3
> """Freeze projected real-source T/V diagnostics using the standard TV CLI suite."""
> import argparse
> import csv
> import io
> import json

>

> ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]

> from tsbench.ingress import sha
> from tsbench.planner.tv import load_case, suite_schema_name
> from tsbench.contracts import load_contract
>
> BASE = 'configs/suites/dev_tv_source_providers_v3/suite.json'
>
>
> def projected(root, entry, window):
>     offset, count, wanted = (window[k] for k in ('start', 'rows', 'value_columns'))
>     require(type(offset) is type(count) is int and 0 <= offset and 513 <= count <= 8192 and offset + count <= entry['rows'] and
>             len(wanted) == len(set(wanted)) == 5 and all(type(i) is int and 0 <= i < entry['value_count'] for i in wanted) and
>             entry['parser']['timestamp'] != 'integer_label', 'invalid civil five-value projection window')
>     t, vs = bytearray(), [bytearray() for _ in wanted]
>     width = entry['value_count']
>     for batch in read_batches(root, entry):
>         lo, hi = max(offset, batch.start), min(offset + count, batch.start + batch.rows)
>         if lo >= hi:
>             continue  # Consume the complete iterator so the source digest is verified.
>         a, b = lo - batch.start, hi - batch.start
>         t.extend(batch.axis[8*a:8*b])
>         for column, out in zip(wanted, vs, strict=True):
>             for row in range(a, b):
>                 pos = 8*(row*width + column)
>                 out.extend(batch.values[pos:pos+8])
>     require(all(len(v) == count*8 for v in [t, *vs]), 'incomplete projection window')
>     return [bytes(v) for v in [t, *vs]]
>
>
> def _npy(array):
>     out = io.BytesIO()
>     np.lib.format.write_array(out, array, version=(1, 0), allow_pickle=False)
>     return out.getvalue()
>
>
> def prepare(root, spec_path, output):
>     request_path = local_file(root, spec_path)
>     request = load_json(request_path)
>     require(request.keys() == {'manifest', 'windows'} and 1 <= len(request['windows']) <= 4, 'unexpected TV projection request')
>     manifest = load_full_manifest(root, request['manifest'], parse=False)
>     entries = {x['id']: x for x in manifest['datasets']}
>     output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
>     base = load_json(local_file(root, BASE))
>     suite = {**base, 'cases': {}, 'source_groups': {}}
>     suite['profiles']['raw-t'] = {'plugin': 'raw-timestamp', 'role': 'timestamp', 'options': {}}
>     suite['methods']['raw-t-alp-f64'] = {'timestamp': 'raw-t', 'value': 'alp-f64'}
>     provenance = {}
>     for group, cfg in request['windows'].items():
>         require(group and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789-' for c in group), 'invalid TV group name')
>         require(cfg.keys() == {'dataset', 'start', 'rows', 'value_columns'} and cfg['dataset'] in entries,
>                 'unsupported TV projection config')
>         entry = entries[cfg['dataset']]
>         t, *v = projected(root, entry, cfg)
>         rows = cfg['rows']
>         names = ['timestamp', *(entry['columns'][1+i] for i in cfg['value_columns'])]
>         spec = {'timestamp': {'name': 'timestamp', 'dtype': 'i64', 'unit': 's',
>                              'interpretation': 'source_civil_label_coordinate_not_utc', 'epoch': '1970-01-01 00:00:00', 'timezone': None},

### 本轮完成
- 补齐 pcodec Auto/Pages 的 23 项和 Zstd/XZ 批基线的 11 项。[r38 独立审计](./results/m3-real-r38-20261120/batch-specialist-audit.json)确认 34 项专项通过，禁网重放 42 个专项产物，其中 3 个是符合合同的预期拒绝。
- 新增主账本复算，发现 **8 个语料决定不符合冻结分块**：ETTm1、ETTm2 的 pcodec Auto 和 ALP 各 4 个。ALP 语料后端对照也尚未证明多个后端独立解码了**同一份产物**。这些开发回验不计正式通过。
- 在 ETTm1 和 national-illness 的真实数据投影上完成固定 T、固定 V 两类跨格式对照，[18 个组合产物全部独立恢复](./results/m3-tv-real-sources-20261120-r2/restore.json)。

### 总体进度

**本轮完成**：修正 ALP、pcodec Auto、Zstd、XZ 共 6 条批处理路线。ETTm1、ETTm2 原先不符合冻结边界的 8 个决定已复测通过：每列按 **65,536 + 4,144 行**提交；Zstd/XZ 则按 **65,536 字节**切块并验证尾块。ALP 后端对照确认 **28 个帧各只编码一次，再由两个禁网进程独立解码同一帧**。6 次定向预检的账本复算均无单元边界不符，`tsbench` 环境中 14 项回归测试通过。详见 [r39 执行记录](./docs/contracts/m3-real-corpus-plan.md#alp、pcodec-autozstdxz-的冻结单元与独立恢复r39-开发预检)。

**总体进度**：M0–M2 已有新版验收收据；M3、M4 尚未验收；M5、M6 尚未进入新版验收。M3 的 828 个文件—路线决定已冻结，180 项必需义务和 6 项条件义务均已绑定驱动，**不等于正式通过**。已知质量拒绝和原生失败保持原状态；ALP AVX512BW 已编译，仍待支持该指令集的宿主复验。204 个展示格、264 项原子关系尚无新版正式资格结论。

**本轮完成**：在同一主账本中，对 ETTm1、ETTm2、Economics-17 的 6 条批处理路线完成 **18/18 项真实输入验证**。按冻结的首块／短块规则保留 30 个引用，去重后为 25 个帧；在不挂载原始输入的禁网进程中完成 **35 次独立重放**。另用同一批真实输入和参考帧验证了动态加载、直接链接两种测量入口，共 **140 次双向调用**；这次只验证入口正确性，未保留计时样本。`tsbench` 环境中 16 项回归测试通过。[留样审计](./results/m3-real-r40-20261120/retention-audit.json) · [双入口预检](./results/m3-real-r40-20261120/timing-lane-probe.json)

**总体进度**：M0–M2 已有新版验收收据；M3、M4 尚未验收，M5、M6 尚未进入新版验收。M3 已冻结 828 个决定，180 项必需义务和 6 项条件义务均已绑定驱动，但尚未完成同一主账本的全量验收。已有原生失败、质量拒绝及 ALP AVX512BW 待宿主复验的状态保持不变；204 个展示格和 264 项原子关系尚无新版正式资格结论。

**下一轮任务**：用已验证的双入口冻结真实输入测量计划，执行预热、校准、匹配随机轮次及双向复测，交付可从原始账本复算的时间、字节和资源明细；继续补齐 T-only、V-only 真实恢复及不兼容输入拒绝。

>
> - [测量计划](../../results/m3-fixed-batch-timing-r1-20261120/plan.json)只覆盖 r40 的三个真实文件、六条路线、30 个封存引用与 35 个样本/解码请求组合。每项冻结原始范围、原值与 schema 摘要、完整参考帧、ABI 模块和原生依赖、双入口程序及 r40 独立重放证据。各组合分 `steady`（reset 计入）和 `cold`（上下文构建/析构计入，不含进程启动），共 70 个比较组。

> - 同一计划两次分别封账：[第一轮](../../results/m3-fixed-batch-timing-r1-20261120/runs/d25677a74f6142a3a91d3af43f877e20/report.json)、[第二轮](../../results/m3-fixed-batch-timing-r1-20261120/runs/ad5d8fa03c384241a2dbee086e11de21/report.json)。每次 560 批（140 校准、420 测量）全部核验，210 个完整匹配轮。复制只有封存计划、日志及账本的目录后可复算相同报告；修改记录中解码 CPU 端点并重新计算文件摘要，复算仍拒绝。完整帧计入 ABI header、schema 和实际 codec 载荷，吞吐分母仅用原域逻辑值字节。
> - [复测审计](../../results/m3-fixed-batch-timing-r1-20261120/repeat-audit.json)不混合两次运行的样本；按生命周期、入口和方向，组间相对变化绝对值的中位数约 0.48%–1.59%，最大约 41.78%（ETTm1 的 pcodec C Native Auto 首块，steady/dlopen 解码）。核绑 CPU 4，串行执行并取得 TSBench 协作锁，但没有系统级独占或 NUMA 控制；已有观测不能因果归因，不设通过阈值，也不报算法排名。未覆盖其他合法工作负载、全语料、其他原生路线或 M4 剖析。

### 本轮完成
- 完成 [T-only / V-only r2 审计](./results/m3-real-axis-20261120-r2/replay-audit.json)。两类任务各 12 槽通过，脱离源文件禁网重放 144 帧；从冻结输入和恢复产物重建并复现 7 个原生不兼容拒绝及 1 个时间单位不可精确换算拒绝。完整字节账包含清单、帧头、内嵌 schema 和原生载荷，r1 保持不变。
- [核对了独立轴与 T+V 组合的输入谱系](./results/m3-real-axis-20261120-r2/tv-axis-lineage.json)：6 个跨格式用例的行窗、列序、原域摘要和 `source_group_id` 一致。组合运行的 18 个独立恢复槽与轴运行分开保留。已更新目标及合同文档；`tsbench` 中 22 项相关测试通过。

### 总体进度
M0–M2 已有新版阶段收据；M3、M4 的新版验收尚未完成。M3 已冻结 23 个文件、36 条路线、828 个适用性决定（724 个适用）；180 项必需和 6 项条件义务均已绑定驱动，**不等于已通过**。CORAD、ZFP 的质量拒绝、PBEPLA-RR 的原生失败及 ALP AVX512BW 的支持宿主待验状态均保留。M5 的 204 个展示格、264 个原子关系未获正式资格；M6 尚未验收。

### 下一轮任务
在同一真实单 V 投影上对照 **原生 Gorilla TV（Unique C11）** 与 **派生 T+V 组合**，补验路线替换、禁用和不兼容拒绝。随后补齐其余适用路线的双向测量与可复算明细，最终以一个完整冻结计划、一次运行和一份主账本验收 M3，再做与之绑定的 M4 剖析。

### 本轮完成
- 在 ETTm1 和 national-illness 的同一真实单 V 投影上，对照了 **Unique C11 原生 Gorilla TV** 与 **派生 Gorilla-T + Gorilla-V**，并验证固定 T 换 ALP、固定 V 换 raw-T。四种方法在 CSV、NPY、TXT 上共 **24 槽全部独立恢复**；固定支路分别编码，实际产物字节一致，没有跨方法复用码流。
- [门禁审计](./results/m3-tv-native-pair-20261120-r1/controls.json)通过：5 个插件禁用、3 个配置或输入不兼容在调用前拒绝，8 个跨方法误解码在禁网环境中拒绝且未发布文件。已更新目标及合同文档，21 项相关测试通过。

### 总体进度
M0–M2 已有新版收据；M3、M4 尚未验收。本轮已核验 r40 冻结计划，并在**不加路线、数据集或数量筛选**的情况下启动 M3 全量功能运行，[主账本](./results/m3-real-r40-20261120/full-runs/87c4857f6c21490ca2a060b4ed96687d/ledger.jsonl)仍在写入，尚未封账。该运行覆盖 828 个文件—路线决定和 186 项义务，不等于正式性能验收。M5 的 204 个展示格、264 个原子关系未获正式资格；M6 尚未验收。

### 下一轮任务
继续跟踪同一运行，不重启、不拼接。封账后复算决定、义务、留样和实际失败终态，据此补齐 M3 的双向测量与可复算明细，再推进绑定同一真实输入和配置的 M4 剖析。

> ## 全量入口与账本指标明细

> 正式全分母候选不传路线、数据集或数量筛选。`--summary` 只减少终端输出，不改变执行或账本；完整报告仍写入 run。
> 不能从 `python -` / stdin 直接提交函数：CORAD 并行控制器使用 Python `spawn`，必须能重新加载主入口文件。
> [启动尝试记录](../../results/m3-real-r40-20261120/launch-attempt-note.json)保留已中断、未封账的 stdin 尝试，
> 标准入口使用同一计划以新 run 独立执行，不继承或拼接中断账本。
>
> `tools/m3_metric_details.py --plan <计划> --run <已封账运行> --out <新目录>` 按主账本逐条生成 `decisions.jsonl` 和
> 可复算 `summary.json`（不要求把整个账本和报告同时载入内存）。每行绑定源决定、配置、表示、账本行号，分别列出可核实的
> 逻辑字节、完整产物、原生操作或进程诊断钟、后台、CPU 和峰值 RSS；缺项附原因，不能从进程耗时反推缺失的裸 codec 时间，

> 输出为同一运行的诊断视图，不是分片收据、独立恢复审计、M2 计时准入或 M3 阶段通过。

### 本轮完成
- 扩展了 M3 指标复算：共享字典和 Huff0 表每个恢复变体只计一次，训练字节不进入留出压缩比；ZFP 模式、PBEPLA 各层前缀和 CORAD 各生产者分别记账，失败与质量拒绝保留原状态。
- [复算检查](./results/m3-metric-recomputations-20261120-r2/adapter-coverage.json)在 12 份封存定向账本上验证了 33 条路线的字节账或专项指标，并从封存报告额外核对了两条 pcodec 页路线的 46 条记录。19 项相关测试通过；这些检查不合并为全量结果，也未新增正式重复计时。

### 总体进度
M0–M2 已有新版收据；M3、M4 尚未验收。M3 全量运行继续使用同一份[主账本](./results/m3-real-r40-20261120/full-runs/26626570ffeb4ba79905b9eb7dd612ea/ledger.jsonl)，本轮末已写入 **172 条未封账记录**：149 条功能核验通过、23 条域外。当前冻结分母仍为 828 个文件—路线决定和 186 项义务。M5、M6 尚未验收。

### 下一轮任务
继续跟踪同一运行，封账后核对全部决定、义务、失败与留样；同时优先补两条 pcodec 页路线的原域双向重复测量。M4 剖析仍须绑定新版 M3 的真实输入和对应主测配置。

> ## 新合同：绑定真实 M3 输入与配置的三类剖析
>
> [真实输入剖析计划 r3](../../results/m4-real-profile-20261120-r3/plan.json) 对应 r40 冻结项，分别绑定以下封存证据：
>
> | 剖析对象 | 实际输入及配置 | 与 M3 的核对 |
> |---|---|---|
> | ALP 融合 | ETTm2 值列 5 的 `[0,65536)`，原生 Auto 编码、显式 AVX2 FALP 解码。 | r39 共帧功能的 `falp-auto` 在该单元实际选 AVX2；每次解码同样观测到 51 个融合向量。裸产物加回 M3 头及 schema 后与冻结帧的长度和 SHA-256 一致。与 AVX512BW 无关。 |
> | Zstd 多线程 | Weather 全部 8,852,928 B 规范交错 V，level 3、524,288 B job、checksum off。编码两个后台 worker，解码零后台 worker。 | 沿用 r30 已验证的两 worker 帧、每方向 native 输入/输出 span 和 finish 条件；核对原封存帧、实际 17 个 job 和两个 worker。没有把 `workers=2` 当成实测。 |
> | XZ opaque | ETTm1 交错 V 字节 `[0,65536)`，preset 6、check none、单线程裸批。 | 关联封存的 M3 同 ABI 双入口批计时 case，从固定帧解析原生载荷；每次产物加回相同 M3 封装后核对既有帧身份。XZ 内部未插桩，L2 为 `opaque`，时间为 null。 |
>
> [封存账本](../../results/m4-real-profile-20261120-r3/runs/956a56a6325e46d38f0140dc1046f6f3/trials.jsonl) 与 [复算报告](../../results/m4-real-profile-20261120-r3/runs/956a56a6325e46d38f0140dc1046f6f3/report.json) 覆盖 28 个试验、56 次方向调用。每个对象三轮匹配的 pristine、trace-off、profiled 对照另加一次 ALP 容量压力控制。固定各对象解码帧，所有方向输出按长度/摘要与确定的帧或原始值比对。regular profile 无丢失；容量 2 的 ALP 控制令编码丢失 2 个、解码丢失 53 个事件。Zstd worker 跨线程重叠按时间区间并集和重叠报告，不把线程区间和当作总墙钟。20 次开启采集的调用均没有可用的 cycles 计数，保留不可用状态，不填零。
>
> pristine 的 codec 共享库与 M3 构建一致；trace-on/off 共用同一个 overlay 构建，驱动另建、不改历史产物。L0 包围准备、native 操作与清理、序列化，L1 细分这些步骤；规范输入预先物化，Zstd 调用的 span 与源合同相同，但这里缓冲输出后单独写盘。未计 M3 插件封装/源文件 ingress，也不以 L0 差值冒充同边界的框架开销。CPU 12、13、14 只做继承亲和，没有系统级独占；r40 功能运行仍活跃。执行进程受 `prlimit` 约束，但不声称 files-only 隔离；不代替 M3 恢复或主计时。报告可以由 `tools/probe_offline_m4_real_profile.sh` 仅挂载 `tsbench`、控制代码和封存运行，在禁网环境逐字节复算，篡改丢失计数和把 worker span 延伸至 L0 外都被拒绝。该诊断不授予新版 M4 阶段通过或正式计时资格。

> [Weather 诊断计划](../../results/m3-zstd-worker-timing-20261120-r1/plan.json) 使用完整 8,852,928 B 交错 V，不截断输入以迁就通用隔离工具的 8 MiB 上限。仅对冻结 Zstd worker 工具允许较大的输入与输出，`RLIMIT_FSIZE` 仍按每次实际冻结输出预算设置；禁网子进程只挂载一个输入对象及锁定 ELF 闭包。两个编码配置分别验证自己的原生帧；每次解码各自挂载该路线同一份帧，实际解码均为 0 个后台 worker。编码分别观测到 0、2 个后台 worker；[报告](../../results/m3-zstd-worker-timing-20261120-r1/runs/69b21848c8794ab6a6590da7916c36d5/report.json)完成 36 次验证（8 预热、28 测量），只含进程墙钟/CPU/RSS，仍不补造旧工具没有的原生全操作钟。r40 运行当时活跃，不用于排名。[七个适用文件的计划](../../results/m3-zstd-worker-seven-files-20261120-r1/plan.json)在全量功能结束后另行运行：先前释放的大帧只允许在第一预热用未变更的输入及原生配置重建，摘要与原封存记录一致后方可作为固定解码帧，不能把新帧冒充旧留样。
>
> `tools/verify_m3_corpus_custody.py` 从有主账本及报告哈希的单次封账复查 `retained/`、`fixed-batch-samples/` 的全部物理对象，禁止遗漏、额外文件、符号链接和冲突摘要；同一内容寻址对象只计一次物理占用。`--replay-pages` 在禁网进程复解两个原生页路线的固定首块，解码只挂载页帧，外层核对规范值。已在 [两个真实文件 × 两路线的 r40 定向运行](../../results/m3-corpus-custody-preflight-20261120-r1/pcodec-replay.json) 验证 4 个留样及 4 次复解。其他路线的专项产物和已释放的原生帧不由该留存清单证明。

>  先行的 [Titchy 原生包流重复](../../results/m3-titchy-stream-timing-20261120-r1/runs/d33a945ce2ad4168a1b8e8daa900cc4e/report.json) 使用 ETTm1 和 Economics-17 的第一个完整值列；没有把列分块、批处理或通用外置缓冲冒充原生流。两例共独立验证 36 次调用；解码始终只读挂载同一 TSTR 归档与 TSC1 配置。内存驱动双向计时、首次输出、受监督进程墙钟与计费分别记录。进程时间包含原生工具自己执行的复位和背压验证，不与原生动作钟混排。该两例与 r40 功能运行重叠；另有冻结的 23 文件首列计划，明确不代表测量所有列或正式排名。
> +
> +### 同封账固定批处理复解与串行重复诊断
> +
> +`tools/verify_m3_fixed_batch.py --full-ledger --replay` 检查 r40 封印中的主账本和报告哈希，顺序扫描完整输入决定及义务，不在内存中加载明细报告，不从定向预检组装新运行。它复用原留样策略、恢复运行时闭包及逐位恢复断言。<br>

- [Zstd worker 七文件](./results/m3-zstd-worker-seven-files-20261120-r1/runs/b20d44735ed846318c626d46e35a591f/report.json)和 [Titchy 原生流 23 文件](./results/m3-titchy-stream-23files-20261120-r1/runs/04b2c018ad994df68c13d68057171549/report.json)分别完成 252 次和 414 次调用，封账后复算一致。Zstd 仍缺原生全操作时钟；Titchy 每个文件只测第一个完整值列。两者均为诊断，不作正式排名。
- 确认 PBEPLA-RR 的 4 项失败来自两个 Bitcoin 文件上相同的 3 个窗口：两条路线均触发 `RrGrid` 的 30 位分辨率上限，属于原生编码报错，不是质量拒绝。已更新[目标文档](./TSDataCompressBenchMark目标.md)和 [M3 合同](./docs/contracts/m3-real-corpus-plan.md)；`tsbench` 环境下 52 项相关测试通过。

> *** Begin Patch
> *** Update File: docs/contracts/m3-real-corpus-plan.md
> @@
>  逐窗口核对上述 PBEPLA-RR 失败：两条路线在相同的 3 个输入窗口失败。`bitcoin-dataset-without-missing-values-1` 第 0 值列的 `[0, 2291)` 与 `[2291, 4581)`，以及 `bitcoin-dataset-without-missing-values-3` 第 0 值列的 `[0, 4021)`，均由原生控制程序报告 `RrGrid: no resolution up to 30 bits gives a block narrow enough`；同窗在两条路线中的输入 SHA-256 一致。此为原生编码报错，不是因输出未达到冻结质量门槛而拒绝。
> +
> +将 r40 的窗口坐标、输入摘要及两条路线的失败原因对账到 [r25 单窗口复现](../../results/m3-real-r25-20261119/pbepla-rrgrid-counterexamples.json)，三窗全部一致。用该复现记录的首层网格跨度和 `2 × 16` 带宽复算，三个窗口所需**最低首层分辨率**依次为 **31、40、32 位**。经来源锁校验的 `tsbenchmark-algorithms-native` 归档中，`rr_grid.cpp` 的网格构造/自动选择及 `pbepla_rr.cpp` 的 PBEP 解码解析都限制为 30 位，因此仅改执行器配置、强制给出更大分辨率或只改编码器都不能保留 Unique v1 格式兼容性。保留原窗和 `[16, 4, 1]` 门槛下，这是当前选定实现的能力边界；另立兼容性不同的格式，或显式外部划分并计费，是不同的方法，不回填 r40。Unique 基准的按范围比例门槛也不是这次冻结的绝对误差档。
> @@
>  功能全量与留样普查完成后，先执行 [Zstd worker 七文件报告](../../results/m3-zstd-worker-seven-files-20261120-r1/runs/b20d44735ed846318c626d46e35a591f/report.json)（252 次：56 预热、196 测量），再执行 [Titchy 23 文件报告](../../results/m3-titchy-stream-23files-20261120-r1/runs/04b2c018ad994df68c13d68057171549/report.json)（414 次：92 预热、322 测量）。两工具各以 `verify --run` 从各自封存账本复算一致。Zstd 的两编码配置使用完整 V 对象，各自的独立解码只挂载对应固定帧，旧工具仍缺原生全操作时钟；Titchy 的单位是每个文件的第一个完整值列，解码只挂载固定 TSTR 和 TSC1。串行不等于主机独占，这些结果不与先行样例合并成正式测量分布，不授予阶段或服务资格。
> +
> +### 同封账 Titchy 四路线语料留样复解
> +
> +`tools/verify_m3_titchy.py --full-ledger` 不加载全量明细报告，直接核对封印后顺序扫描主账本，检查整份语料与义务分母，并对 Titchy 四条语料路线复算首列/首块对应的源哈希、全文件行列范围和产物分项；原生 batch 与两种访问路线的底层 TCHY 帧逐块核对一致，原生包流仍单列。
> +[r40 Titchy 语料审计](../../results/m3-real-r40-20261120/titchy-corpus-replay-20261120-r1.json) 重放 23 × 4 = 92 份样本。batch/访问进程只挂载各自帧，包流进程只挂载 TSTR 和 TSC1；禁网进程的结果与独立退码及规范输入摘要核对。92 个进程共读取 115 个实体留样，和固定批处理及 pcodec 页复解无重叠，将同一 r40 封印下的三份独立复解审计合计覆盖提高到 306/1,105 个实体留样（333 次调用）。此视图不复验 Titchy 专项产品，也不是全量帧再次解码或性能测量。
> *** End Patch

### 本轮完成
- [Titchy 四条原生路线留样审计](./results/m3-real-r40-20261120/titchy-corpus-replay-20261120-r1.json)直接读取 r40 原封账账本。覆盖 23 个文件的批处理、原生包流、文件访问和范围查询，完成 **92 次独立禁网复解**，核对 **115 个实体留样**。这不等于复解全部帧，也不覆盖专项产物。
- 将 PBEPLA-RR 的三个失败窗口与历史单窗复现逐一对账。在冻结误差门槛下，首层分别至少需要 **31、40、32 位**，而锁定的 Unique v1 编码器和 PBEP 解码器均只支持 30 位。仅改执行器配置无法解决；保留 r40 的 4 项失败，未缩窗、放宽门槛或改格式。`tsbench` 环境下相关回归 **42 项通过、2 项跳过**。

### 总体进度
**M0–M2** 已有新版验收收据；**M3** 全量已封账、未验收；**M4** 已有真实输入剖析、未验收；**M5–M6** 未验收。M3 的 724 个适用项仍为 675 通过、45 质量拒绝、4 运行失败；CORAD 留出质量拒绝和 ALP AVX512BW 待兼容宿主实测的状态不变。同一 r40 封印下，累计独立复解 **306/1,105 个实体留样**。服务矩阵的 204 个展示格、264 个原子关系未新增正式资格。

>  [r40 Titchy 语料审计](../../results/m3-real-r40-20261120/titchy-corpus-replay-20261120-r1.json) 重放 23 × 4 = 92 份样本。batch/访问进程只挂载各自帧，包流进程只挂载 TSTR 和 TSC1；禁网进程的结果与独立解码器结果及规范输入摘要核对。92 个进程共读取 115 个实体留样，和固定批处理及 pcodec 页复解无重叠，将同一 r40 封印下的三份独立复解审计合计覆盖提高到 306/1,105 个实体留样（333 次调用）。此视图不复验 Titchy 专项产品，也不是全量帧再次解码或性能测量。
> +
> +### pcodec 两条页路线：所有适用文件的第一完整值列
> +
> +`tools/m3_pcodec_page_timing.py plan --all-files-first-column` 从同一 r40 封印和完整主账本冻结两条页路线共同适用的文件。仅投影第 0 值列，但覆盖其全部原生页组，不按速度或压缩比筛选；读取原件到 EOF 校验来源身份，不将这段准备成本计入原生耗时。23 个文件共 25 个组，其中 ETTm1、ETTm2 各有 `[65536,69680)` 的尾组。主账本中已释放的尾组产物只可在首预热以冻结配置重建，与各路线的原封存大小和 SHA-256 一致后，才可作为各自固定解码输入；重建不是历史留样。
> +
> +[封存报告](../../results/m3-pcodec-page-first-columns-20261120-r1/runs/f1ffaaf6f9a846409d03b4cf2e035454/report.json) 的 **900 次**独立禁网调用已完成 `verify --run` 复算（200 预热、700 测量）。每组每路线两个方向各 7 个独立测量样本，解码只挂载该路线的固定帧。原生操作的墙钟/CPU、受监督进程墙钟/CPU/RSS、载荷/元数据/组头计费分列；进程钟包括隔离启动和控制程序文件 I/O，不是原始文件至最终产物的全链路计时。CPU 12 继承亲和而非系统级独占；本结果不代表所有值列、正式排名或阶段验收。

### 本轮完成
- 补齐 ALP 融合剖析所用**同一数据单元**的双向计时：ETTm2 第 5 值列（从 0 起算）`[0, 65536)`。重建的完整帧与 r40 主账本及 M4 封印摘要一致；标量与 AVX2 后端独立禁网解码同一帧，AVX2 实测 51 个融合向量。[原生计时报告](./results/m3-alp-m4-exact-20261120-r1/runs/d8e060da99564a3ba2ffccfcae6ae5a7/report.json)的 32 个进程批次全部通过，复算一致。
- 另做了[文件路径端到端诊断](./results/m3-alp-m4-exact-20261120-r1/pipeline-runs/5a44ce1e0ed44a95a74d9fc4bedd16c3/report.json)，编解码各 2 次预热、7 次测量。编码含完整源文件读取、指定列窗编码、独立复解校验和输出同步；解码只挂载固定压缩帧。该诊断与原生操作计时、M4 剖析分别记录。`tsbench` 下 31 项相关测试通过。

### 总体进度
**M0–M2** 已有新版验收收据；**M3** 全量已封账、未验收，724 个适用项仍为 675 通过、45 质量拒绝、4 运行失败；**M4** 三类代表剖析均已有相同输入和配置的独立计时对照，仍未验收；**M5–M6** 未验收。r40 实体留样独立复解仍为 306/1,105，本轮重建帧不冒充历史留样。服务矩阵未新增正式资格。

### 下一轮任务
优先补 Sprintz-FIRE、Huff0 等尚缺的双向重复测量和查询、共享表等专项成本，同时继续从 r40 原封印复验剩余留样与专项产物。保留 CORAD 质量拒绝、PBEPLA-RR 失败及 ALP AVX512BW 待兼容宿主实测的状态。

> def info(path):

> def schedule(fmt):

> def freeze(root, plan_path, run, cpu):

>                         cost = {'abi_header': ENVELOPE.size, 'schema': proof['schema']['bytes'], 'fec_header': FEC.size,

>                         require(sum(cost.values()) == frame['frame']['bytes'], 'Huff0 FEC1 sample byte charge differs')
>                         cases.append({**common, 'format': 'FEC1', 'canonical_value_byte_range': [offset, offset + frame['decoded']['bytes']],

>                     continue

>                 require(sum(cost.values()) == lane['complete_bytes'], 'Huff0 ETB1 billing differs')

> def protocol(case, op):
>     if case['format'] == 'FEC1':
>         lib = '/runtime/lib/libbmk_huff0_reference.so'
>         if op == 'encode':
>             return ('raw', 'schema'), [op, lib, '/inputs/raw', '/inputs/schema', '/out/result']
>         return ('frame',), [op, lib, '/inputs/frame', '/out/result']
>     if op == 'train':
>         return ('train',), [op, str(case['streams']), '/inputs/train', '/out/result']
>     names = ('model', 'holdout' if op == 'encode' else 'blocks')
>     return names, [op, *('/inputs/' + p for p in names), '/out/result']
>
>
> def expected(case, op):
>     if case['format'] == 'FEC1':
>         frame, raw = case['artifact'], case['original']
>         obs = {'frames': 1, 'input_bytes': raw['bytes'], 'frame_bytes': frame['bytes']}
>         return ({'raw': raw, 'schema': case['schema']}, frame, obs) if op == 'encode' else ({'frame': frame}, raw, obs)
>     art = case['artifact']
>     model, blocks = art['model.etb1'], art['test.blocks']
>     mounts, output = {'train': ({'train': case['training']}, model),
>                       'encode': ({'model': model, 'holdout': case['original']}, blocks),
>                       'decode': ({'model': model, 'blocks': blocks}, case['original'])}[op]
>     return mounts, output, case['native'][op]
>
>
> def invoke(run, plan, case, work, op, paths):
>     names, argv = protocol(case, op)
>     executable = FEC1_TOOL if case['format'] == 'FEC1' else ETB1_TOOL
>     work.mkdir()
>     if case['format'] == 'ETB1' and op == 'decode':
>         checked_identity(paths['binding'].read_bytes(), case['streams'], info(paths['model']), info(paths['blocks']))
>     out, proc = invoke_isolated_tool(run / case['format'], plan['runtime'][case['format']], executable, LIMITS,
>                                      work, work, op, {n: paths[n] for n in names}, argv, lambda: False,
>                                      observe=True, file_ceiling=LIMITS['file_bytes'])
>     stderr = work / (op + '.stderr')
>     require(proc['status'] == 'completed' and proc['returncode'] == 0 and stderr.stat().st_size == 0 and
>             {p.name for p in out.iterdir()} == {'result'},
>             f"Huff0 isolated {op}: {proc['status']}: {stderr.read_text()[:300]}")
>     return out / 'result', proc, load_json(work / (op + '.stdout'))
>

> def validate(case, row, trial, seen):
>     op = trial['operation']

>             0 < p['process_wall_ns'] <= row['staged_supervision_wall_ns'] and p['child_usage']['maxrss_bytes'] > 0,
>             'Huff0 repeat trial does not reproduce frozen mount, output, metadata or clock')
>     seen.add(p['session_id'])

> def prepare(run, plan, case, item, entry, work, seen):

>     trial = {'operation': 'decode', 'phase': 'untimed_recovery', 'round': -1}

> def observe(run, plan, case, work, trial, paths):
>     tick = monotonic_ns()
>     out, proc, meta = invoke(run, plan, case, work, trial['operation'], paths)
>     identity = info(out)
>     return out, proc, (meta, identity), monotonic_ns() - tick

> def observation(case, trial, proc, obs, output, wall):
>     del output  # The output digest was computed before the outer clock stopped.
>     meta, ident = obs
>     return {'case_id': case['case_id'], **trial, 'process': proc, 'native_observation': meta,
>             'output': ident, 'staged_supervision_wall_ns': wall}
>

> def summarize(case, rows):
>     result = {}
>     for op in OPS[case['format']]:
>         measured = [r for r in rows if r['operation'] == op and r['phase'] == 'measured']

>         logical = case['training' if op == 'train' else 'original']['bytes']
>         result[op] = {'logical_bytes': logical, 'native_wall_ns': None,
>                       'repeat_distributions': {k: {**distribution(v), 'sample_basis': LIFECYCLE} for k, v in clocks.items()},

>         'cost': case['cost'], 'artifact_bytes': sum(case['cost'].values()),

> ### Sprintz-FIRE：冻结 SFB1 留样及 17 个整文件的编解码与查询重复
>
> - [`m3_sprintz_query_timing.py`](../../tools/m3_sprintz_query_timing.py) 从 **r40 完整主账本**冻结查询路线，保持原有 SFB1 驱动、四条 little-endian `u16` limb、每列最多 8,192 行/帧和单原生线程。按每例、每操作一次预热和三次测量，方向随机次序预定；每次独立进程、CPU 6 亲和、TSBench 协作锁、Bubblewrap 禁网。编码逐帧对账完整 SFB1 摘要；解码只挂 SFB1，逐列逐块核验恢复位。准备阶段以恢复位或锁定源文件重建独立 COUNT/SUM/MAX oracle。原生 `upstream_simd` 与 `scalar` 分项记录，但同进程每帧先自动、后标量；不能用整段进程钟计算两种后端的独立查询性能，也不能把位片查询当成 f64 查询。
> - [留样报告](../../results/m3-sprintz-query-repeats-20261120-r1/retained-runs/917d2fc9105948a1aa8240ff960b7088/report.json) 覆盖 23/23 文件各一份第 0 列首帧，276 次方向试验。 [整文件报告](../../results/m3-sprintz-query-repeats-20261120-r1/whole-bounded-runs/388d455603064417aeaabfc9ee455b44/report.json) 覆盖 17/23 文件的全部行、全部 V 列（340 个 SFB1 单元、19,267,376 B 逻辑值），共 204 次方向试验。LD2011–2014、Electricity、Traffic 的整文件产物超过隔离驱动的单文件限额，只有首帧诊断；后续应改用适配此规模的受限整文件运行，不能把首帧当成整文件。整文件归档为重建且逐帧对 r40，不增加历史留样数；这两次也不替代 `fire-batch` 公共 ABI 路线的独立重复。
> - 原生 codec/查询调用、禁网进程和父进程从**已准备输入**发起到核验结果的壁钟分开。源文件读取、列物化、重建准备和产物持久化不在外层试验钟内。`wait4` 统计对应受监督的进程包装器及其执行路径，不是 codec 内部 CPU/RSS，也不证明系统级独占。两份报告独立重算一致，不签发阶段或性能准入。
>
> ### Huff0：FEC1 原生帧与 ETB1 共享表分开核算
>
> - [封存报告](../../results/m3-huff0-corpus-repeats-20261120-r1/runs/b328886785c5461bb395d764468e7191/report.json) 对账 23 个文件的 **35 份 FEC1 首/尾实体留样**，及 16 个文件的 **32 个 ETB1 完整留出变体**（1X/4X 各自独立）。每份留样先做禁网独立恢复，另做各操作一次预热、三次测量。FEC1 只用 ABI 帧复解并对照原始摘要、schema 及块 CRC，按 ABI 头、schema、FEC1 头、记录头与各模式载荷计费；不将首/尾帧当作全文件。ETB1 从锁定原件独立读取训练前缀和留出值，禁网训练进程只挂载训练前缀，编码只挂载对应模型和留出值，解码只挂载模型和块流；SHA-256 sidecar 在进程外校验并随模型、块流完整计费一次，训练输入不计入留出压缩比。14 个没有历史完整留样的 ETB1 变体明列缺测。
> - 共 **731** 次隔离调用（67 次额外复解、166 次预热、498 次测量），报告从试验账本独立重算一致。沿用 r40 的原生控制程序，其输出没有原生 wall clock，因此 `native_wall_ns` 为 `null`，不以子进程钟填充；只报告隔离进程及从已准备输入开始的监督和输出核验成本。没有测量原件到持久产物的全链路、无正式排名。
> - 两条新诊断合计复核 r40 语料实体清单中 **154 份不重复文件**（Sprintz 23；FEC1 35；ETB1 32 × 模型、块流、sidecar 三件）。按物理路径、字节和摘要对账，和既有 pcodec 页、固定批处理、Titchy 审计不重叠：累计 **460 / 1,105**，还剩 645 份语料留样不在这些复解范围内。专项产物、全部时序帧及阶段正式验收另计。

### 本轮完成
- **Sprintz-FIRE**：基于 r40 封账，完成 23 个文件的首帧复解与重复测量，并覆盖其中 17 个文件的全部行和全部值列，共 480 次禁网方向试验。压缩域查询分别记录 SIMD 和标量耗时；查询的是四路 `u16` 位片，不是原始 `f64` 数值。另 6 个文件受隔离驱动的单文件限额约束，仍只有首帧证据。
- **Huff0**：复解并重复测量 35 份 FEC1 首尾帧、32 个 ETB1 完整留出变体，分别核算编解码、训练和共享表成本。冻结驱动没有原生时钟，报告保留缺测，未用进程耗时替代。
- 三份报告均独立复算一致，新核验 **154 份**历史实体留样。`tsbench` 下 25 项相关测试通过（含单独启用的禁网测试）。结果已写入 [M3 真实语料合同](./docs/contracts/m3-real-corpus-plan.md)。

### 总体进度
M0–M2 已有新版验收凭据。M3 的 r40 全量主账本已封账，历史实体留样复核累计 **460 / 1,105**，尚未通过阶段验收。M4 的三类代表剖析已有对应的独立计时诊断，也尚未验收。本轮未更改 r40 原有结论，未授予正式性能排名资格。

### 下一轮任务
补 Sprintz 公共 ABI 批处理的双向原生重复，并解决 6 个大文件的整文件测量限制；为 Huff0 补独立原生时钟和从源文件到持久产物的端到端测量。同时继续复核剩余 **645 份**历史留样和专项产物，逐条对照 M3、M4 的退出条件。

> cat > native/measurement/huff0_etb1/main.cpp <<'EOF'
> // Separate observation runner; keep the historic ETB1 control and wire unchanged.
> #include "entropy_port.hpp"
>
> #include <charconv>
> #include <chrono>
> #include <filesystem>
> #include <fstream>
> #include <iomanip>
> #include <iostream>
> #include <sched.h>
> #include <sstream>
> #include <stdexcept>
> #include <string_view>
>
> namespace {
> namespace ep = entropy_port;
> namespace fs = std::filesystem;
> using Clock = std::chrono::steady_clock;
> static_assert(Clock::is_steady);
> constexpr size_t header = 9;
>
> void check(bool condition, const char *reason) {
>     if (!condition) throw std::runtime_error(reason);
> }
> uint64_t ns_since(Clock::time_point t) {
>     return std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::nanoseconds>(Clock::now()-t).count();
> }
> uint32_t le(const uint8_t *p) {
>     return uint32_t(p[0]) | (uint32_t(p[1]) << 8) | (uint32_t(p[2]) << 16) | (uint32_t(p[3]) << 24);
> }
> ep::Bytes read_short(const fs::path& path, size_t max_size) {
>     std::ifstream in(path, std::ios::binary | std::ios::ate);
>     auto n = in.tellg();
>     check(n > 0 && uint64_t(n) <= max_size, "invalid train/model extent");
>     ep::Bytes out(static_cast<size_t>(n));
>     in.seekg(0);
>     check(bool(in.read(reinterpret_cast<char *>(out.data()), n)) && in.peek() == EOF && !in.bad(), "short train/model read");
>     return out;
> }
> void write(std::ofstream &out, const ep::Bytes &data) {
>     check(bool(out.write(reinterpret_cast<const char *>(data.data()), data.size())), "cannot write output");
> }
> void finish(std::ofstream &out) { out.close(); check(out.good(), "cannot close output"); }
> std::string name(size_t i) {
>     std::ostringstream text;
>     text << 'g' << std::setfill('0') << std::setw(5) << i << ".bin";
>     return text.str();
> }
> std::vector<size_t> parse_groups(std::string_view text) {
>     std::vector<size_t> groups;
>     while (!text.empty()) {
>         const auto comma = text.find(',');
>         const auto field = text.substr(0, comma);
>         size_t n{};
>         const auto r = std::from_chars(field.data(), field.data()+field.size(), n);
>         check(r.ec == std::errc{} && r.ptr == field.data()+field.size() && n && n <= 256 && groups.size() < 10000,
>               "invalid ETB1 group block count");
>         groups.push_back(n);
>         if (comma == std::string_view::npos) break;
>         text.remove_prefix(comma+1);
>         check(!text.empty(), "trailing ETB1 group delimiter");
>     }
>     check(!groups.empty(), "ETB1 has no groups");
>     return groups;
> }
> void report(const ep::TableCodec &codec, size_t blocks, size_t raw, size_t wire,
>             uint64_t setup, uint64_t calls, int cpu0) {
>     std::cout << "{\"streams\":" << codec.huffman_streams() << ",\"effective_table_log\":" << codec.effective_table_log()
>               << ",\"blocks\":" << blocks << ",\"raw_bytes\":" << raw << ",\"wire_bytes\":" << wire << ",\"context_count\":1"
>               << ",\"table_wall_ns\":" << setup << ",\"block_calls_wall_ns\":" << calls
>               << ",\"cpu_endpoints\":[" << cpu0 << ',' << sched_getcpu() << "]}\n";
>     check(std::cout.good(), "ETB1 observation write failed");
> }
> void train(std::string_view lanes, const fs::path &source, const fs::path &dest) {
>     check(lanes == "1" || lanes == "4", "unsupported ETB1 stream count");
>     const auto raw = read_short(source, ep::block_size);
>     const auto cpu = sched_getcpu();
>     const auto t = Clock::now();
>     const ep::TableCodec codec(ep::Algorithm::Huff, raw, 0, lanes == "1" ? 1 : 4);
>     const auto setup = ns_since(t);
>     std::ofstream out(dest, std::ios::binary);
>     write(out, codec.model());
>     finish(out);
>     report(codec, 0, raw.size(), codec.model().size(), setup, 0, cpu);
> }
> void transfer(bool encode, const fs::path &model_path, const fs::path &src, const fs::path &dst,
>               const std::vector<size_t> &groups) {
>     const auto model = read_short(model_path, 1024);
>     check(model.size() >= 8 && model[4] == unsigned(ep::Algorithm::Huff), "not a Huff0 model");
>     const auto cpu = sched_getcpu();
>     const auto started = Clock::now();
>     const ep::TableCodec codec(model);
>     const auto setup = ns_since(started);
>     ep::Bytes block;
>     size_t blocks = 0, raw = 0, wire = 0;
>     uint64_t calls = 0;
>     for (size_t g = 0; g < groups.size(); ++g) {
>         std::ifstream in(src / name(g), std::ios::binary);
>         std::ofstream out(dst / name(g), std::ios::binary);
>         check(in && out, "ETB1 group open failed");
>         for (size_t b = 0; b < groups[g]; ++b) {
>             const bool tail = g+1 == groups.size() && b+1 == groups[g];
>             if (encode) {
>                 block.resize(ep::block_size);
>                 in.read(reinterpret_cast<char *>(block.data()), block.size());
>                 const auto n = in.gcount();
>                 check(n > 0 && (tail || n == static_cast<std::streamsize>(ep::block_size)) && !in.bad(), "bad held-out block length");
>                 block.resize(static_cast<size_t>(n));
>                 const auto t = Clock::now();
>                 const auto encoded = codec.encode_block(block);
>                 calls += ns_since(t);
>                 check(encoded.size() >= header && encoded.size() <= n+header, "bad ETB1 wire length");
>                 write(out, encoded);
>                 raw += n; wire += encoded.size();
>             } else {
>                 block.resize(header);
>                 check(bool(in.read(reinterpret_cast<char *>(block.data()), header)), "short ETB1 block header");
>                 const auto len = le(block.data()+1), n = le(block.data()+5);
>                 check(len > 0 && len <= ep::block_size && (tail || len == ep::block_size) && n > 0 && n <= len,
>                       "bad ETB1 restored extent");
>                 block.resize(header+n);
>                 check(bool(in.read(reinterpret_cast<char *>(block.data()+header), n)), "short ETB1 block body");
>                 const auto t = Clock::now();
>                 const auto decoded = codec.decode_block(block);
>                 calls += ns_since(t);
>                 check(decoded.size() == len, "ETB1 decoded length differs");
>                 write(out, decoded);
>                 raw += len; wire += block.size();
>             }
>             ++blocks;
>         }
>         check(in.peek() == EOF && in.eof() && !in.bad(), "trailing ETB1 group bytes");
>         finish(out);
>     }
>     report(codec, blocks, raw, wire, setup, calls, cpu);
> }
> }
>
> int main(int argc, char **argv) {
>     try {
>         const std::string_view op = argc > 1 ? argv[1] : "";
>         if (op == "train" && argc == 5) train(argv[2], argv[3], argv[4]);
>         else if ((op == "encode" || op == "decode") && argc == 6)
>             transfer(op == "encode", argv[2], argv[3], argv[4], parse_groups(argv[5]));
>         else throw std::runtime_error("expected train STREAMS TRAIN MODEL or encode|decode MODEL INPUT OUTPUT BLOCK_COUNTS");
>         return 0;
>     } catch (const std::exception &e) {
>         std::cerr << "ETB1 timing: " << e.what() << '\n';
>         return 1;

> ### Sprintz SFB1：23 文件全值域和耐久文件路径

> [计划](../../results/m3-sprintz-durable-corpus-20261120-r1/plan.json)与[封存报告](../../results/m3-sprintz-durable-corpus-20261120-r1/runs/80ce0d15d38f4e429d7713fc1b6d4181/report.json)绑定 r40 的 `query` 路线、每帧摘要和原 Unique Sprintz DSO。新驱动对同一个完整文件仍只建一个 native codec context，每列仍按 8,192 行/帧访问；只是按完整列边界，把原顺序 SFB1 字节写入多个有界文件（每个≤6 MiB）。不增加归档头、不切原生帧、不按文件分组计算独立样本。新增证据包括此前隔离限制下缺整文件重复的 LD2011–2014、Electricity、Traffic；r40 的全部 23 个文件、11,610 个 SFB1 单元均覆盖，逻辑 622,954,272 B、完整产物 446,781,266 B。重建归档逐帧核对 r40，不增加历史留样数。

> 每文件每操作 1 次预热、3 次测量，276 次独立禁网进程试验（207 次测量），一份账本，复算结果一致。编码外层从锁定原件读取、校验与列物化开始，到逐帧核验、输出文件和目录 `fsync` 为止；解码外层从挂载已核验的完整 SFB1 归档开始，到原域位校验、列文件及目录 `fsync` 为止。完整源文件字节数与原任务逻辑 V 字节分列。原生、受监督进程、端到端时钟各自报告；端到端不含未计时参考重建和试验目录清理，`fsync` 不被描述成已通过崩溃恢复。查询还是四路 `u16` 的 COUNT/SUM/MAX，所有帧均对独立原位 oracle；同进程每帧顺序跑 SIMD、标量，报告两路 native latency、共同顺序扫描的 SFB1 字节，物理读量不填零。进程资源是 `wait4` 路径口径；无协调器／整路径 CPU/RSS，无系统独占或排名资格。

### 本轮完成
- **Sprintz SFB1**：补齐此前受单文件限额影响的 6 个大文件，统一实测全部 23 个文件的全行、全值列。完成 276 次禁网试验，分列原生调用、进程耗时，以及包含原件读取、结果核验和 `fsync` 的编解码端到端耗时。查询仍是四路 `u16` 位片聚合，不是原始 `f64` 查询。[封存报告](./results/m3-sprintz-durable-corpus-20261120-r1/runs/80ce0d15d38f4e429d7713fc1b6d4181/report.json)
- **Huff0 ETB1**：覆盖 23 个文件的全部 46 个 1X／4X 完整留出变体，共 552 次禁网试验。补齐原生训练、表加载、编码和解码时钟；从原件解析到模型、块流和绑定信息一并持久化的端到端耗时仍未测量。[封存报告](./results/m3-huff0-etb1-timing-20261120-r1/runs/47264af273894c98abdbb04e092b79a6/report.json)
- **SElf\***：独立复解 46 份 r40 历史首列帧，另重放 25 个专项终态（18 个验证通过、7 个预期拒绝）。两份计时报告独立复算一致，`tsbench` 下 13 项相关测试通过。

### 总体进度
M0–M2 已有新版验收凭据。M3 的 r40 主账本已封账，历史实体留样复核累计 **529 / 1,105**，尚余 576 份。M3、M4 仍未验收；本轮没有改写 r40 终态，也没有将诊断结果用于正式排名。

### 下一轮任务
优先补 SElf\* 批处理与增量路线的双向重复计量，以及 ETB1 从原件到完整持久产物的端到端测量。继续复核剩余留样和专项产物，并逐项对照新版 M3、M4 退出条件。

> #!/usr/bin/env python3
> """Replay Gorilla historical TV frames and snapshots against original T/V in a sealed M3 run."""
> import argparse
> from collections import Counter, defaultdict
> from pathlib import Path
>
> from verify_m3_gorilla import ROOT, ROUTES, audit_regression, audit_specialized, replay_corpus
> import numpy as np
> from tsbench.application.batch_execution import _files
> from tsbench.application.m3_gorilla import RECORD, ROWS, milliseconds
> from tsbench.application.m3_gorilla_specialized import NAMES
> from tsbench.application.m3_sealed_ledger import full_run_rows, full_run_source
> from tsbench.application.smoke import write_new
> from tsbench.assets import ContractError, content_id, load_json, require, verify_asset
> from tsbench.corpus_ingress import read_batches
>
>
> def original_chunk(root, entry):
>     """Check the complete declared source identity; keep only the first TV chunk."""
>     require(entry['axis']['unit'] == 'second', 'Gorilla audit requires original civil-second samples')
>     rows, cols = min(ROWS, entry['rows']), entry['value_count']
>     result = np.empty(rows, dtype=RECORD)
>     consumed = 0
>     for batch in read_batches(root, entry):
>         require(batch.start == consumed, 'Gorilla source batches out of order')
>         n = min(batch.rows, rows-batch.start)
>         if n > 0:
>             result['t'][batch.start:batch.start+n] = milliseconds(np.frombuffer(batch.axis, dtype='<i8')[:n])
>             result['v'][batch.start:batch.start+n] = np.frombuffer(batch.values, dtype='<u8').reshape(batch.rows, cols)[:n,0]
>         consumed += batch.rows
>     require(consumed == entry['rows'], 'Gorilla full source extent differs')
>     return result.tobytes()
>
>
> def audit(root, plan_path, run):
>     plan = load_json(plan_path)
>     ledger, seal = full_run_source(plan, run)
>     products, regression, obligations, rows = defaultdict(dict), None, [], []
>     for row, scope in full_run_rows(plan, ledger):
>         if row.get('selection') != 7:
>             continue
>         kind = row.get('entry_kind')
>         if kind == 'specialized_product':
>             lane, slot = row['lane'], row['product_slot']
>             require(lane in NAMES and slot not in products[lane], 'unexpected or duplicate Gorilla specialist')
>             products[lane][slot] = {k: v for k, v in row.items() if k not in ('entry_kind','selection','lane')}
>         elif kind == 'specialized_obligation':
>             obligations.append({k: v for k, v in row.items() if k != 'entry_kind'})
>         elif kind == 'implementation_regression':
>             require(regression is None, 'duplicate Gorilla repair regression')
>             regression = row
>         elif kind is None:
>             require(row['route'] in ROUTES, 'unexpected Gorilla corpus route')
>             rows.append((row,scope))
>     require(len(rows) == 69 and len({(r['dataset_id'],r['route']) for r,_ in rows}) == len(rows) and
>             len(obligations) == 12 and regression is not None, 'incomplete Gorilla full-ledger projection')
>     repair = plan['build']['gorilla_state_repair']['repair_build']
>     for asset in (repair['programs']['tsbench_gorilla_corpus_control'], repair['dependency']):
>         require(verify_asset(root, asset).stat().st_size == asset['bytes'], 'Gorilla repair build extent differs')
>     corpus = replay_corpus(root, plan, run, rows, source_oracle=original_chunk)
>     require(not corpus['failures'], 'Gorilla repaired corpus must not suppress failures')
>     binding = plan['specialized']['gorilla']
>     lanes = {}
>     for lane, fixtures in products.items():
>         directory = f'gorilla-specialized/{NAMES[lane]}'
>         lane_plan = binding['tv_batch' if lane == 'tv-batch' else 'state']
>         lanes[lane] = {'directory': directory, 'recovery_id': lane_plan['decoder']['recovery_id'],
>                        'fixtures': fixtures, 'statuses': dict(Counter(r['status'] for r in fixtures.values())),
>                        'files': _files(run/directory)}
>     specialist = audit_specialized(root, run, binding, obligations, {'driver':binding['driver'],'lanes':lanes}, replay=True)
>     samples = corpus['independently_decoded_samples']
>     require(len(samples) == len({r['path'] for r in samples}), 'Gorilla corpus samples share physical files')
>     doc = {'schema':'bmk.m3-gorilla-full-ledger-audit/1', 'run_id':run.name, 'run_seal_id':seal,
>            'plan_id':plan['plan_content_id'], **corpus, 'specialized':specialist, 'regression':audit_regression(run,regression),
>            'replayed_physical_files':len(samples), 'oracle':'original_first_chunk_column_0_civil_ms_and_binary64_bits',
>            'corpus_decoder':'independent_python_xorchunk_parser',
>            'timing_admitted':False, 'qualification_granted':False, 'stage_accepted':False}
>     return {**doc, 'audit_id':content_id(doc)}
>
>
> def main():
>     parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
>     for n in ('plan','run','out'):
>         parser.add_argument('--'+n, type=Path, required=True)
>     args = parser.parse_args()
>     try:
>         result = audit(ROOT, args.plan, args.run.resolve(strict=True))
>         write_new(args.out, result)
>         print(result['audit_id'], result['replayed_physical_files'])
>     except (ContractError, OSError, ValueError) as exc:
>         parser.exit(1, f'{exc}\n')
>
>
> if __name__ == '__main__':
>     main()

### 本轮完成
- **Huff0 ETB1**：完成 23 个文件、46 个 1X/4X 变体的端到端诊断，共 **368 次试验**。编码从原件读取、训练和留出编码计到耐久发布；解码只挂载模型与压缩块。封存报告独立复算一致。
- **SElf\***：完成原生 batch 与原生 incremental 两条路线的全语料双向诊断，共 **368 次试验**，报告独立复算一致。保留两种计时边界的差异，不据此直接排名。
- 独立复核 **489 份** ZFP、PBEPLA-RR 和 Gorilla 历史留样。确认 Gorilla TV 仍使用 Unique 的 **C11** 实现，状态路线用同源 C11 修复版，没有换成 C++ codec。本轮相关测试 **31 通过、5 跳过**。

### 总体进度

> #!/usr/bin/env python3
> """Generate a new synthetic civil-second multivariate input, not a new real corpus source."""
> from argparse import ArgumentParser
> from datetime import datetime, timedelta
> from pathlib import Path
> import sys
>
> ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
> sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT/'src'))
> from tsbench.application.smoke import write_new
> from tsbench.assets import digest
> from tsbench.corpus_ingress import axis_contract, fingerprint, PARTITIONS
>
> ROWS = 4099
> BOUNDS = (0, 2048, 3072, ROWS)
> ID = 'm3-switch-synthetic-civil-v1'
> RAW = Path('datasets/fixtures/m3-input-switch-v1/civil-periodic.csv')
> MANIFEST = Path('datasets/manifests/m3-input-switch-synthetic-v1.json')
>
>
> def generate(root):
>     path = root/RAW
>     path.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
>     columns = ['timestamp','triangular_a','triangular_b','band']
>     origin = datetime(2001,2,3,4,5,6)
>     with path.open('x',encoding='ascii',newline='\n') as f:
>         f.write(','.join(columns)+'\n')
>         for row in range(ROWS):
>             t = (origin+timedelta(seconds=3*row+row//97)).isoformat(sep=' ')
>             a, b = row%64, (row+11)%64
>             f.write(f'{t},{2+min(a,64-a)/64},{3+min(b,64-b)/32},{4+(row//64%5)/16}\n')
>     entry = {'id':ID, 'source_cluster':ID, 'file':{'path':RAW.as_posix(),'bytes':path.stat().st_size,'sha256':digest(path)},
>              'parser':{'format':'utf8_delimited_physical_rows_v1','separator':',','decimal':'.','timestamp':'civil_iso_seconds',
>                        'missing':'reject_empty_preserve_finite'},'columns':columns,'axis':axis_contract('civil_iso_seconds'),
>              'values_dtype':'<f8','rows':ROWS,'value_count':3,
>              'partitions':[{'name':n,'start':BOUNDS[i],'end':BOUNDS[i+1]} for i,n in enumerate(PARTITIONS)]}
>     entry.update(fingerprint(root,entry))
>     write_new(root/MANIFEST,{'schema':'bmk.full-corpus/1','scope':'same_entry_synthetic_switch_v1','datasets':[entry]})
>
>
> if __name__=='__main__':
>     p=ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
>     p.parse_args()
>     generate(ROOT)

> #pragma once
>
> #include <chrono>
> #include <cstdint>
> #include <iostream>
> #include <sstream>
> #include <utility>
>
> namespace lzbench_clock {
> using Clock = std::chrono::steady_clock;
> inline std::int64_t elapsed(Clock::time_point start) {
>     return std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::nanoseconds>(Clock::now() - start).count();
> }
> struct Bucket {
>     std::uint64_t calls = 0;
>     std::int64_t wall_ns = 0;
>     template<class F> decltype(auto) measure(F&& action) {
>         struct Span {
>             Bucket& bucket;
>             Clock::time_point start = Clock::now();
>             ~Span() { ++bucket.calls; bucket.wall_ns += elapsed(start); }
>         } scope{*this};
>         return std::forward<F>(action)();
>     }
>     void print() const { std::cout << "{\"calls\":" << calls << ",\"wall_ns\":" << wall_ns << '}'; }
> };
> struct Trial {
>     Clock::time_point start;
>     std::int64_t first_output_ns = 0;
>     std::size_t first_output_bytes = 0;
>     Bucket setup, process, framing, cleanup;
>     std::ostringstream functional;
>     void output(std::size_t bytes) {
>         if (bytes && !first_output_bytes) {
>             first_output_ns = elapsed(start);
>             first_output_bytes = bytes;
>         }
>     }
>     void print() const {
>         const auto driver_wall_ns = elapsed(start);
>         std::cout << "{\"driver_wall_ns\":" << driver_wall_ns
>                   << ",\"first_driver_output_wall_ns\":" << first_output_ns
>                   << ",\"first_driver_output_bytes\":" << first_output_bytes << ",\"native_setup\":";
>         setup.print();
>         std::cout << ",\"native_process\":"; process.print();
>         std::cout << ",\"native_framing\":"; framing.print();
>         std::cout << ",\"native_cleanup\":"; cleanup.print();
>         std::cout << ",\"functional\":" << functional.str() << "}\n";
>     }
> };
> } // namespace lzbench_clock

> FILE_CEILING = 128 << 20
> ADDRESS_SPACE = 1 << 30
> WALL_SECONDS = 60
>
>
> def run(bundle, spec, scratch, source, codec, family, direction, lane, cap):
>     require(codec in ('xz', 'zstd') and direction in ('encode', 'decode') and
>             family in TOOLS and type(cap) is int and 0 < cap <= FILE_CEILING and
>             source.is_absolute() and source.is_file() and not source.is_symlink() and
>             0 < source.stat().st_size <= FILE_CEILING and scratch.is_absolute(), 'invalid lzbench clock launch extent')

>         args = [lane]

>     argv = [LAUNCHERS[0], f'--as={ADDRESS_SPACE}:{ADDRESS_SPACE}', f'--fsize={cap}:{cap}', '--core=0:0',

>             '--clearenv', '--cap-drop', 'ALL']

> def _population(plan, ledger, source_run):
>     cases, conditional = [], []
>     rng = Random(SEED)
>     for row, item in full_run_rows(plan, ledger):
>         if row.get('entry_kind') is not None or item['route'] not in ROUTES:
>             continue
>         route = item['route']
>         codec, family = route.split('-')
>         body = {k: item[k] for k in ('dataset_id', 'route', 'work_item_id', 'operation_config_id', 'canonical_object_id')}
>         if item['applicability'] == 'condition_not_triggered':
>             require(family == 'workers' and row['status'] == 'condition_not_triggered', 'unexpected lzbench conditional row')
>             conditional.append({**body, 'reasons': item['reasons']})
>             continue
>         require(item['applicability'] == 'input_domain_matches' and row['status'] == 'verified',
>                 'applicable lzbench reference is not verified')
>         e = row['evidence']
>         require(e['codec'] == codec and (family != 'workers' or not outcome(e)), 'lzbench worker reference differs')
>         lanes = LANES[codec] if family == 'workers' else ('session',)
>         variants = {lane: _variant(e, lane) for lane in lanes}
>         for v in variants.values():
>             if v['retain'] is not None:
>                 require(v['frame'] == {k: v['retain'][k] for k in ('bytes', 'sha256')}, 'lzbench retained reference differs')
>                 _file(source_run, v['retain'])
>             require(0 < v['frame']['bytes'] <= launcher.FILE_CEILING, 'lzbench frame exceeds file budget')
>         n = e['source']['bytes']
>         require(0 < n and _encode_cap(n) <= launcher.FILE_CEILING, 'lzbench source exceeds file budget')
>         body.update(codec=codec, family=family, source=e['source'], variants=variants, scope=item['input']['row_ranges'],
>                     order=[rng.sample(lanes, len(lanes)) for _ in range(WARMUPS + ROUNDS)])
>         cases.append({**body, 'case_id': content_id(body)})
>     population = [(c['dataset_id'], c['route']) for c in cases + conditional]
>     datasets = {d for d, _ in population}
>     require(datasets and Counter(population) == Counter((d, r) for d in datasets for r in ROUTES),
>             'lzbench population omits or duplicates a dataset/route decision')
>     return cases, conditional
>

> def freeze(root, source_plan, source_run, build, cpus):
>     require(list(cpus) == sorted(set(cpus)) and len(cpus) >= 2, 'choose at least two distinct measurement CPUs')
>     environment = [resource.environment(cpu) for cpu in cpus]
>     require(len({(e['package_id'], e['core_id']) for e in environment}) == len(cpus), 'choose distinct physical cores')
>     plan = load_json(source_plan)
>     ledger, seal_id = full_run_source(plan, source_run)
>     cases, conditional = _population(plan, ledger, source_run)
>     bindings = [plan['build'][name] for name in ('lzbench_session', 'lzbench_workers')]
>     lib = bindings[0]['dependency']
>     require(bindings[1]['dependency'] == lib, 'lzbench baseline references different native libraries')
>     lib_path = _file(root, lib)
>     for binding in bindings:
>         _file(root, binding['executable'])
>         for name, sha256 in binding['code'].items():
>             require(digest(local_file(root, name)) == sha256, 'lzbench frozen control code differs')
>     archives = [_ref(root, local_file(lib_path.parent, 'upstream/libln_kernels.a'))]
>     headers = lib_path.parent / 'source/lzbench-native'
>     header_deps = [headers / 'include' / n for n in ('lzbench_extended.hpp', 'lzbench_native.h')]
>     xz_api = headers / 'vendor/lzbench/lz/xz/src/liblzma/api'
>     header_deps += [xz_api / 'lzma.h', *sorted((xz_api / 'lzma').glob('*.h'))]
>     tools = {k: _ref(root, local_file(build, name)) for k, name in launcher.TOOLS.items()}
>     closure = plan_recovery(root, {}, (), tools={k: {n: r[n] for n in ('path', 'sha256')} for k, r in tools.items()}, libraries=[lib])
>     require(all('liblzbench_native.so' in closure['files'][p]['needed'] for p in closure['tools'].values()),
>             'clock driver is missing the frozen lzbench library')
>     body = {
>         'schema': SCHEMA, 'source_plan': _ref(root, source_plan), 'source_run': source_run.relative_to(root).as_posix(),
>         'source_seal': seal_id, 'definition': plan['definition']['plan'], 'build': build.relative_to(root).as_posix(),
>         'cases': cases, 'conditional': conditional, 'environment': environment, 'policy': POLICY,
>         'runtime': closure, 'archived_link_inputs': archives, 'headers': [_ref(root, p) for p in header_deps],
>         'launchers': launcher_lock(), 'tools': tools, 'code': [_ref(root, local_file(root, n)) for n in (
>             *(f'native/measurement/lzbench_corpus/{s}' for s in SOURCES), *(f'src/tsbench/{s}' for s in CODE),
>             'tools/m3_lzbench_corpus_clock.py')],
>     }
>     return {**body, 'plan_content_id': content_id(body)}
>
>
> def _encode_cap(n):
>     return n + n // 10 + 65536
>
>
> def _schedule(case):
>     ident = case['case_id']
>     for i, lanes in enumerate(case['order']):
>         for op in DIRECTIONS:
>             for lane in lanes:
>                 yield {'case_id': ident, 'phase': 'warmup' if i < WARMUPS else 'measured',
>                        'round': i + 1 if i < WARMUPS else i + 1 - WARMUPS,
>                        'direction': op, 'lane': lane, 'path': f'cases/{ident}/{i+1:02d}-{op}-{lane}'}
>
>
> def _verify_clocks(case, trial, clocks, process, path_timing, sessions):
>     direct = clocks['functional']
>     op, lane = trial['direction'], trial['lane']
>     expected = case['variants'][lane]['expected'][op]
>     product = _verify_native(case, trial, direct, process, sessions)
>     require(direct['jobs'] == expected['jobs'], 'lzbench actual worker-hook job accounting differs from reference')
>     expected_keys = {*BUCKETS, 'functional', 'driver_wall_ns', 'first_driver_output_wall_ns', 'first_driver_output_bytes'}
>     require(set(clocks) == expected_keys and all(type(clocks[k]) is int for k in
>             ('driver_wall_ns', 'first_driver_output_wall_ns', 'first_driver_output_bytes')) and
>             0 < clocks['first_driver_output_wall_ns'] <= clocks['driver_wall_ns'] <= process['process_wall_ns'] and
>             0 < clocks['first_driver_output_bytes'] <= product['bytes'], 'lzbench clock scopes or first output differ')
>     for key in BUCKETS:
>         bucket = clocks[key]
>         require(set(bucket) == {'calls', 'wall_ns'} and all(type(v) is int and v >= 0 for v in bucket.values()) and
>                 (bucket['calls'] == 0) == (bucket['wall_ns'] == 0), 'lzbench native bucket differs')
>     require(0 < sum(clocks[k]['wall_ns'] for k in BUCKETS) <= clocks['driver_wall_ns'], 'lzbench native call wall sum differs')
>     counts = [clocks[k]['calls'] for k in BUCKETS]
>     if lane == 'synchronous' and op == 'encode':
>         blocks = expected['blocks']
>         fallback = expected['uncompressed_fallback_blocks']
>         require(direct['blocks'] == direct['calls'] == blocks and direct['uncompressed_fallback_blocks'] == fallback and
>                 counts[0] == blocks + 2 and counts[1] >= blocks + fallback and counts[2] == 6 + 4 * blocks - fallback and
>                 counts[3] == blocks + 1 and clocks['first_driver_output_bytes'] == 12, 'XZ synchronous native operation coverage differs')
>     else:
>         require(counts == [1 if lane == 'synchronous' else 2, direct['calls'], 0, 1] and
>                 (direct.get('blocks', 0), direct.get('uncompressed_fallback_blocks', 0)) == (0, 0),
>                 'lzbench span call accounting differs')
>     if lane == 'session':
>         require(direct['first_output_bytes'] == clocks['first_driver_output_bytes'] and
>                 direct['first_output_driver_wall_ns'] <= clocks['first_driver_output_wall_ns'], 'session first output clock differs')
>     require(set(path_timing) == {'source_to_synced_output_wall_ns', 'output_fsync_wall_ns'} and
>             all(type(v) is int and v > 0 for v in path_timing.values()) and process['process_wall_ns'] +
>             path_timing['output_fsync_wall_ns'] <= path_timing['source_to_synced_output_wall_ns'], 'lzbench durable path clock differs')
>     return product
>
>
> def _fsync_output(output, stop):
>     with output.open('rb') as stream:
>         os.fsync(stream.fileno())
>     folder = output.parent
>     while folder != stop:
>         fd = os.open(folder, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_CLOEXEC | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
>         try:
>             os.fsync(fd)
>         finally:
>             os.close(fd)
>         folder = folder.parent
>
>
> def _call(run, plan, case, scratch, source, op, lane):
>     cap = case['source']['bytes']
>     native_lane = '0' if case['route'] == 'zstd-workers' and op == 'decode' else lane
>     start = monotonic_ns()
>     out, proc = launcher.run(run / 'runtime', plan['runtime'], scratch, source, case['codec'], case['family'],
>                              op, native_lane, _encode_cap(cap) if op == 'encode' else cap)
>     stdout, stderr = scratch / 'native.stdout', scratch / 'native.stderr'
>     require(proc['status'] == 'completed' and proc['returncode'] == 0 and stderr.stat().st_size == 0 and
>             {p.name for p in out.iterdir()} == {'object'}, f"{case['dataset_id']} {case['route']} {op}/{lane}: {proc['status']} {stderr.read_text()[:500]}")
>     output = out / 'object'
>     require(output.is_file() and not output.is_symlink(), 'unexpected lzbench output file type')
>     sync_start = monotonic_ns()
>     _fsync_output(output, run.parent)
>     end = monotonic_ns()
>     return output, proc, load_json(stdout), {'source_to_synced_output_wall_ns': end - start,
>                                             'output_fsync_wall_ns': end - sync_start}, [_ref(run, p) for p in (stdout, stderr)]
>
>
> def _prepare(root, run, plan, case, raw, source_run):
>     frames = {}
>     for lane, v in case['variants'].items():
>         dest = run / 'cases' / case['case_id'] / f'{lane}.frame'
>         if v['retain'] is not None:
>             shutil.copyfile(_file(source_run, v['retain']), dest)
>         else:
>             scratch = dest.parent / f'prepare-{lane}'
>             scratch.mkdir()
>             output, _, _, _, _ = _call(run, plan, case, scratch, raw, 'encode', lane)
>             require(artifact(output) == v['frame'], 'released lzbench frame could not be reconstructed')
>             output.replace(dest)
>         require(artifact(dest) == v['frame'] and ('wire' not in v or wire_info(dest, case['codec'], case['source']['bytes']) == v['wire']),
>                 'lzbench anchor differs from sealed bytes or wire')
>         frames[lane] = dest
>     return frames
>

> def _run_trial(run, plan, case, trial, raw, frames, sessions):
>     scratch = run / trial['path']
>     scratch.mkdir()
>     op, lane = trial['direction'], trial['lane']
>     v = case['variants'][lane]
>     decode_input = frames[v['decode_anchor']]
>     output, process, clocks, path_timing, logs = _call(run, plan, case, scratch, raw if op == 'encode' else decode_input, op, lane)
>     wanted = _verify_clocks(case, trial, clocks, process, path_timing, sessions)
>     require(artifact(output) == wanted and filecmp.cmp(output, frames[lane] if op == 'encode' else raw, shallow=False),
>             'lzbench trial output differs from frozen frame or original-domain V bytes')
>     output.unlink()
>     output.parent.rmdir()
>     return {**trial, 'native': clocks, 'process': process, 'path_timing': path_timing, 'output': wanted, 'logs': logs}
>

>
> [冻结计划](../../results/m3-lzbench-corpus-clock-20261120-r1/plan.json)直接从 r40 全量封存账本投影：`zstd-session` 23、`xz-session` 23、`zstd-workers` 7、`xz-workers` 9，共 **62 个适用决定**；另外保留 Zstd 16、XZ 14 个未触发决定。独立构建 `native/measurement/lzbench_corpus`，历史控制程序、r40 计划与账本不变。两个时钟工具链接同一锁定的 `liblzbench_native.so`；XZ 同步解码入口与原控制一样，使用该构建的 vendored `libln_kernels.a` 中的 `lzma_stream_decoder`（共享库本身不导出此符号）。冻结 ELF 闭包、静态链接输入、头文件及源代码摘要。
>
> - 会话方向使用 307/521 B 游标及全对象单一原生会话。Worker 编解码保留原读写 span，Zstd 两编码配置各自对应独立的零 worker 解码，XZ 三个解码 lane 比较同一 lane-2 帧。历史已释放帧在预热和测量之外重建，验证与 r40 已封存字节数和摘要一致；在测量中固定帧不变。
> - 原生计时分为初始化、推进、封装、释放四个不重叠的调用墙钟区间之和。同步 XZ 编码包含 Block、fallback、Stream header/footer 和 Index 等原生调用，不仅是 `lzma_code`。并行等待可能包含在调用墙钟中，不能换算为多线程 CPU 时间。驱动第一输出对同步 XZ 编码是 12 B Stream header，不等于首次有效载荷。
> - 单列驱动墙钟、`wait4` 进程墙钟/CPU/RSS，以及从已经落盘的规范输入或固定帧，经隔离启动到输出文件及父目录 `fsync` 的路径墙钟。最后一条**不包含从最初 CSV/TXT 的解析，也不替代全管线计时**。每次检验相同配置、worker hook 的实际工作、输入挂载摘要和结果字节；输出逐字节核对后回收，保存固定帧、原始日志与账本。
> - 同一 UID 的协作资源锁，绑定两个不同物理核；不宣称系统级独占或冷缓存。每个 lane 预热一次、测量三次；不授予 M3/M4 阶段或排名资格。
>

### 本轮完成
- 用同一 `bmk` 入口完成 [NOAA 独立真实输入复验](./results/m3-input-switch-noaa-uscrn-20261120-r1/audit.json)，审计可复算。36 个决定中 **31 通过、2 质量拒绝、1 域外、2 未触发**。12 项算法均有原生执行和校验证据，11 项至少一条路线通过；PBEPLA-RR 的两条路线因精确误差略超阈值，保留拒绝。
- 新增 Zstd/XZ 原生计时工具，分别记录原生调用、驱动、进程和输出同步时间。首轮发现 XZ 多线程解码的 hook 次数会随调度变化；已修正验证逻辑，仍核对实际后台线程数、固定帧和恢复字节。[r2 全量计时](./results/m3-lzbench-corpus-clock-20261120-r2/plan.json)已启动，覆盖 62 个适用决定，尚未封账。相关回归测试 23 通过、6 跳过。

### 总体进度
**M0–M2 已验收；M3 全量功能运行已封账，但尚未验收；M4 尚未验收。** NOAA 复验不改写 r40 的失败、质量拒绝或 AVX512BW 待验状态。M5/M6 正式资格未授予。

> // An equivalent public-ABI operation, with and without the production Context wrapper.
> #include "plugin_loader.hpp"
>
> #include <charconv>
> #include <chrono>
> #include <cstring>
> #include <fstream>
> #include <iostream>
> #include <new>
> #include <optional>
> #include <sched.h>
> #include <string>
> #include <vector>
>
> namespace {
> struct Calls { size_t new_calls{}, new_bytes{}, memcpy_calls{}, memcpy_bytes{}; };
> #ifdef TSBENCH_COUNT_ABI_CALLSITE
> thread_local Calls *observed = nullptr;
> #endif
> }
> #ifdef TSBENCH_COUNT_ABI_CALLSITE
> extern "C" void *__real__Znwm(size_t);
> extern "C" void *__wrap__Znwm(size_t n) {
>     auto *p = __real__Znwm(n);
>     if (observed) { ++observed->new_calls; observed->new_bytes += n; }
>     return p;
> }
> extern "C" void *__real_memcpy(void *, const void *, size_t);
> extern "C" void *__wrap_memcpy(void *dst, const void *src, size_t n) {
>     auto *p = __real_memcpy(dst, src, n);
>     if (observed) { ++observed->memcpy_calls; observed->memcpy_bytes += n; }
>     return p;
> }
> #endif
>
> namespace {
> using Clock = std::chrono::steady_clock;
> using Bytes = std::vector<uint8_t>;
> constexpr size_t cap = 64 * 1024 * 1024 + 65536;
> struct Span { int64_t ns = 0; Calls counts; };
>
> template<class F> Span observe(F &&do_work) {
>     Span span;
>     const auto start = Clock::now();
> #ifdef TSBENCH_COUNT_ABI_CALLSITE
>     struct Guard {
>         explicit Guard(Calls &row) { observed = &row; }
>         ~Guard() { observed = nullptr; }
>     } guard(span.counts);
> #endif
>     do_work();
>     span.ns = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::nanoseconds>(Clock::now() - start).count();
>     return span;
> }
> void require(bool value, const char *reason) { if (!value) throw std::runtime_error(reason); }
> size_t number(std::string_view s) {
>     size_t n{};
>     const auto r = std::from_chars(s.data(), s.data() + s.size(), n);
>     require(r.ec == std::errc{} && r.ptr == s.data() + s.size() && n > 0 && n <= cap, "invalid array extent");
>     return n;
> }
> Bytes read(const char *path, size_t limit) {
>     std::ifstream in(path, std::ios::ate | std::ios::binary);
>     const auto n = in.tellg();
>     require(n > 0 && static_cast<uint64_t>(n) <= limit, "invalid input file extent");
>     Bytes out(static_cast<size_t>(n));
>     in.seekg(0);
>     require(bool(in.read(reinterpret_cast<char *>(out.data()), n)) && in.peek() == EOF && !in.bad(), "short or changed input file");
>     return out;
> }
> void output(const char *path, const void *p, size_t n) {
>     require(p && n && n <= cap, "invalid bounded output extent");
>     std::ofstream out(path, std::ios::binary | std::ios::trunc);
>     out.write(static_cast<const char *>(p), static_cast<std::streamsize>(n));
>     out.close();
>     require(bool(out), "cannot write result");
> }
> void check_blob(const bmk_blob &b) {
>     require(b.struct_size >= sizeof(b) && b.release && b.size <= b.capacity && (b.data || !b.size), "bad ABI frame ownership");
> }
> void check_object(const bmk_owned_object &o) {
>     require(o.struct_size >= sizeof(o) && o.release && o.view.struct_size >= sizeof(o.view) &&
>             (!o.view.column_count || o.view.columns) && (!o.view.schema_bytes || o.view.schema_json), "bad ABI restored object ownership");
> }
> struct Direct {
>     const bmk_plugin_v1 &api;
>     bmk_host_v1 host{sizeof(host), BMK_ABI_V1, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr};
>     bmk_context *ctx = nullptr;
>     Direct(const bmk_plugin_v1 &api_, std::string_view opt) : api(api_) {
>         const auto status = api.create(&host, reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t *>(opt.data()), opt.size(), &ctx);
>         if (status != BMK_OK || !ctx) {
>             if (ctx) api.destroy(ctx);
>             throw std::runtime_error("ABI create failed");
>         }
>     }
>     ~Direct() { api.destroy(ctx); }
>     Direct(const Direct &) = delete;
> };
> struct Owners {
>     bmk_blob frame{};
>     bmk_owned_object values{};
>     std::unique_ptr<tsbench::Blob> abi_frame;
>     std::unique_ptr<tsbench::Object> abi_values;
>     Owners() { frame.struct_size = sizeof(frame); values.struct_size = sizeof(values); }
>     ~Owners() { release(); }
>     void release() noexcept {
>         if (frame.release) { frame.release(&frame); frame.release = nullptr; }
>         if (values.release) { values.release(&values); values.release = nullptr; }
>         abi_frame.reset(); abi_values.reset();
>     }
>     const bmk_blob &blob() const { return abi_frame ? abi_frame->get() : frame; }
>     const bmk_object_view &view() const { return abi_values ? abi_values->get() : values.view; }
> };
> const uint8_t *restored(const bmk_object_view &o, const Bytes &schema, const bmk_array_view &wanted) {
>     require(o.column_count == 1 && o.columns && o.schema_bytes == schema.size() && o.schema_json &&
>             std::memcmp(o.schema_json, schema.data(), schema.size()) == 0, "different restored schema");
>     const auto &c = o.columns[0];
>     require(c.struct_size >= sizeof(c) && c.dtype == wanted.dtype && c.rank == 1 && !c.flags && !c.validity &&
>             !c.validity_bytes && !c.validity_bit_offset && c.shape[0] == wanted.shape[0] && c.strides_bytes[0] == wanted.strides_bytes[0] &&
>             c.storage && c.origin_offset <= c.storage_bytes && wanted.storage_bytes <= c.storage_bytes - c.origin_offset,
>             "different restored typed view");
>     return static_cast<const uint8_t *>(c.storage) + c.origin_offset;
> }
> void print(const char *name, const Span &s) {
>     std::cout << ",\"" << name << "\":{";
> #ifdef TSBENCH_COUNT_ABI_CALLSITE

>               << ",\"memcpy_calls\":" << c.memcpy_calls << ",\"memcpy_bytes\":" << c.memcpy_bytes << "}}";
> #else
>     std::cout << "\"wall_ns\":" << s.ns << ",\"counts\":null}";
> #endif
> }
>

>     const size_t width = dtype == BMK_F64 ? 8 : 1;
>     require(n <= (64 * 1024 * 1024) / width, "paired logical extent exceeds limit");
>     const auto source = read(argv[7], cap);

>     require(!enc || source.size() == n * width, "typed original extent differs");
>     bmk_array_view col{};
>     col.struct_size = sizeof(col); col.dtype = dtype; col.rank = 1;
>     col.storage = enc ? source.data() : nullptr; col.storage_bytes = n * width;
>     col.shape[0] = n; col.strides_bytes[0] = static_cast<int64_t>(width);
>     const bmk_object_view input{sizeof(input), 1, &col, schema.data(), schema.size()};
>     const auto module = tsbench::PluginModule::load(argv[5], plugin);
>     std::optional<Direct> plain;
>     std::optional<tsbench::Context> framework;
>     const auto create = [&] { if (direct) plain.emplace(module->api(), opt); else framework.emplace(module, opt); };
>     const auto reset = [&] {

>         else framework->reset(0);

>         } else if (enc) { out.abi_frame = framework->encode(input); }

>     if (steady) {

> }

> ### 同等 public ABI 工作：生产 Context 与直接 ABI（功能预检）

> 新增独立 `native/measurement/m4_abi_cost` 驱动。两个 lane 共用生产插件加载验证和同一冻结 DSO，直接 lane 使用 ABI callbacks 与栈上所有权句柄，框架 lane 经过生产 `tsbench::Context`；两者相同的配置、类型、输入、原生上下文生命周期与校验后端。分别观察 `cold`（计入 create）与 `steady_reset`（同一上下文先预热，再明确 reset）而不混合分布；result-ready 结束在序列化之前，另记输出 release 和 context destroy。独立解码只挂载固定帧及类型 schema，不挂载源值。
>
> 计数二进制与 timing-only 二进制分开，计数臂的墙钟不进入 timing-only 分布。计数覆盖调用方可链接拦截的 `operator new(size_t)` 及 out-of-line `memcpy`；不宣称捕获 DSO/stdlib 内部分配、内联复制或缓存命中。驱动报告的调用顺序经实际回调、同产物比较和返回的原生信息检查，不用拆开的裸内核结果估算适配费用。

> MODULES = {p: 'lib/libbmk_' + p.replace('-', '_') + '.so' for p in ('raw-store', 'zstd', 'alp-auto', 'xz-baseline')}
> LIMITS = {'address_space_bytes': 1 << 29, 'file_bytes': 1 << 20, 'wall_seconds': 15}
> RAW_FILE_CEILING = 32 << 20
>
>
> def run(bundle, spec, scratch, plugin, mode, arm, lifecycle, direction, inputs, count, dtype, ceiling):
>     executable = spec['tools'][mode]
>     library = spec['plugins'][plugin]
>     require(executable == 'bin/' + TOOLS[mode] and library == MODULES[plugin] and
>             arm in ('direct', 'framework') and lifecycle in ('cold', 'steady_reset') and direction in ('encode', 'decode') and
>             type(count) is int and count > 0 and dtype in (2, 10) and set(inputs) == {'object', 'schema'}, 'unbound M4 ABI launch')
>     options = '{"decode_backend":"falp-auto"}' if plugin == 'alp-auto' else '{}'
>     args = [arm, lifecycle, direction, plugin, f'{MOUNT}/{library}', options,
>             '/inputs/object', '/inputs/schema', str(count), str(dtype), '/out/result']
>     if ceiling == LIMITS['file_bytes']:
>         return _invoke(bundle, spec, LIMITS, scratch, scratch, 'cost', inputs, executable, [library], args, lambda: False, observe=True)
>     # The generic isolation limit is unchanged. Only the exact raw-store
>     # control/host executables may see a byte view large enough to cross LLC.
>     require(plugin == 'raw-store' and dtype == 2 and type(ceiling) is int and 8 << 20 < ceiling <= RAW_FILE_CEILING and
>             count < ceiling and scratch.is_absolute(), 'invalid large M4 raw-store extent')
>     output = scratch / 'out'
>     output.mkdir()
>     as_limit = LIMITS['address_space_bytes']
>     argv = [LAUNCHERS[0], f'--as={as_limit}:{as_limit}', f'--fsize={ceiling}:{ceiling}', '--core=0:0',
>             '--', LAUNCHERS[1], '--unshare-net', '--unshare-pid', '--unshare-ipc', '--die-with-parent', '--clearenv', '--cap-drop', 'ALL']
>     for name in program_files(spec, [executable, library]):
>         ref = spec['files'][name]
>         path = verify_asset(bundle, {'path': name, 'sha256': ref['sha256']})
>         require(path.stat().st_size == ref['bytes'], 'large M4 ABI runtime extent differs')
>         argv.extend(('--ro-bind', str(path), f'{MOUNT}/{name}'))
>     mounts = {}
>     for name, path in sorted(inputs.items()):
>         require(path.is_absolute() and path.is_file() and not path.is_symlink() and

>         mounts[name] = {'bytes': path.stat().st_size, 'sha256': digest(path)}
>         argv.extend(('--ro-bind', str(path), f'/inputs/{name}'))
>     argv.extend(('--bind', str(output), '/out', '--chdir', '/out', '--', f"{MOUNT}/{spec['loader']}", '--inhibit-cache',
>                  '--library-path', f'{MOUNT}/lib', f'{MOUNT}/{executable}', *args))
>     proc = invoke(argv, scratch, scratch, 'cost', LIMITS['wall_seconds'], lambda: False, environment={},
>                   observe_process=True, capture_usage=True)
>     if proc['pid'] is not None:
>         proc['input_mounts'] = mounts
>     if proc['returncode'] in {-SIGXFSZ, 128 + SIGXFSZ} and proc['status'] in {'crash', 'failed'}:
>         proc.update(status='file_limit_signal', reason='large M4 raw-store received SIGXFSZ')
>     elif proc['status'] == 'failed' and (scratch / 'cost.stderr').read_bytes()[:7] == b'bwrap: ':
>         proc.update(status='sandbox_failed', reason='Bubblewrap setup failed; see stderr')
>     return output, proc

> ### 多尺度对照的冻结设计
>
> `configs/experiments/measurement_controls/m4_abi_cost_v1.json` 固定真实源窗口：ETTh1 小消息及 64 KiB 边界、ETTm2 的 ALP 1,024 元素向量两侧与同原剖析 `[0,65536)` 精确单元，以及 LD2011 两种原样字节视图。Zstd/XZ 批处理 ABI 在 64 KiB 以上不生成计时样本；上侧对照为仍合法的 raw-store/ALP，不能误当成 Zstd/XZ 已支持更大块。LD2011 小对象核对名义载荷、帧和恢复物的尺寸预算低于本机 L2；大对象仅逻辑输入已经超过固定 CPU 的共享 LLC。两者既不证明缓存冷热，也不比较不同插件的 cache 命中率。
>
> 每个配置、生命周期、方向均以五个独立配对轮记录 `framework − direct` 的带符号分布；每对 lane 运行顺序预先随机化。计数单列，不进入时钟分布。每次实际输出校对完整字节，解码不挂载原值；21 MiB 以上仅限指定 raw-store 字节视图和两个锁定二进制，不放宽通用隔离工具的上限。直接/框架差值局限于相同 public ABI 的 `Context` 路径；源解析、调用入口/装载、结果序列化另有边界，不能从 M3 成绩统一扣减。

### 本轮完成
- **M3：** [Zstd/XZ 原生计时 r2](./results/m3-lzbench-corpus-clock-20261120-r2/runs/e024fe67fcbd4436b3451dc1809dad38/report.json)已封账并独立复算，覆盖 62 个适用决定和 696 次方向试验，另保留 30 个未触发决定。已复用同一批固定帧启动全量耐久路径计时，纳入原始 CSV/TXT 解析、产物校验和文件同步，尚未封账。
- **M4：** [多尺度同等 ABI 对照](./results/m4-abi-cost-20261120-r1/runs/e39284f8e8364a57aecd47a1de34e4f2/report.json)完成 1,008 次方向试验，覆盖小消息、块边界和按本机缓存容量划分的两档输入。计数与计时分开记录；[跨证据对账](./results/m4-abi-cost-20261120-r1/profile-link.json)核对了 ALP 和 Weather Zstd 与既有剖析的输入、固定帧和实际后端。

### 总体进度
**M0–M2 已验收；M3、M4 尚未签发新版验收收据。** 本轮补齐了 Zstd/XZ 四条路线的全量原生时钟和 M4 多尺度对照证据，未改写 r40 的拒绝、失败或硬件待验结果。

### 下一轮任务
复算全量耐久路径报告；优先梳理并补齐 Gorilla 三条原生路线的双向重复计时，再按更新后的验收条目核对 M3/M4 剩余缺口。

> ### Gorilla C11：全文件固定帧重复诊断（计划冻结，尚未运行）
>
> [冻结计划](../../results/m3-gorilla-corpus-clock-20261120-r1/plan.json)从 r40 封存账本逐行投影 Gorilla 的 **69** 个决定（每路线 16 个适用、7 个域外），不加载详细总报告。每条适用路线共有 **153,713** 个列块，按原账本每 512 行分块；不因隔离上限而截断大文件。`tv-batch` 的隔离闭包只绑定 Unique C11 原版，`append-resume` 和 `iterator` 绑定同源状态修复版；两份同名 `libgorilla_c.so` 不同挂载。C++ 文件是调用 C11 的控制器，不是替代算法。
>
> 每个文件—路线一次原件到规范 TV 的准备、一次固定帧/必要快照的重建及逐块对账，再做 1 次预热和 3 次测量。后续编码产物必须逐字节匹配固定帧摘要；各解码进程只挂载相应 GTV1，通过恢复的 TV 位模式及 iterator seek 对完整块序列核对 r40。该工具专用的 128 MiB 上限是**单文件**上限，通用隔离执行器的上限不变。记录批量双向、状态生命周期已计的五段和独立快照复解、迭代创建/遍历/seek，不将历史控制器未计的 encoder 创建/释放、reset 和内部批量字节对照算入原生调用钟。以原件准备、原生调用总钟、监督进程墙钟及 `wait4` CPU/RSS、从准备好输入到各输出文件与输出目录 `fsync` 的钟、完整语义校验钟分别报告。不声称原件到耐久完成的同一段计时、冷缓存、系统级独占、断电恢复或正式性能资格。

> // Reuse exactly the legacy page-group caller (including lifecycle and clocks).
> // The PGF1 object is a harness envelope; each contained PM3PAGE1 frame is unchanged.
> #define TSBENCH_PCODEC_GROUPED 1
> #include "pages_control.cpp"
> #include <algorithm>
> #include <fstream>
>
> namespace {
> constexpr char raw_magic[8] = {'P','G','F','1','R','A','W','\0'};
> constexpr char frame_magic[8] = {'P','G','F','1','P','A','G','E'};
> constexpr size_t max_columns = 4096, max_rows = 10000000;
>
> size_t number(const char *text, size_t max) {
>     const std::string_view s(text);
>     size_t n = 0;
>     const auto [end, err] = std::from_chars(s.data(), s.data() + s.size(), n);
>     check(err == std::errc{} && end == s.data() + s.size() && n && n <= max, "invalid declared corpus geometry");
>     return n;
> }
> void write(std::ostream &out, const void *value, size_t n) {
>     check(bool(out.write(static_cast<const char *>(value), static_cast<std::streamsize>(n))), "grouped page write failed");
> }
> void read(std::istream &in, void *value, size_t n) {
>     check(bool(in.read(static_cast<char *>(value), static_cast<std::streamsize>(n))), "short grouped page record");
> }
> void u32(std::ostream &out, size_t value) {
>     check(value <= UINT32_MAX, "grouped page integer overflow");
>     const uint8_t a[] = {uint8_t(value), uint8_t(value >> 8), uint8_t(value >> 16), uint8_t(value >> 24)};
>     write(out, a, sizeof(a));
> }
> size_t u32(std::istream &in) {
>     uint8_t a[4];
>     read(in, a, sizeof(a));
>     return size_t(a[0]) | size_t(a[1]) << 8 | size_t(a[2]) << 16 | size_t(a[3]) << 24;
> }
>
> template<class Api>
> void grouped(bool encode, size_t cols, size_t rows, const char *source, const char *dest) {
>     std::ifstream in(source, std::ios::binary);
>     check(bool(in), "grouped page input open failed");
>     char received[8];
>     read(in, received, sizeof(received));
>     check(std::memcmp(received, encode ? raw_magic : frame_magic, sizeof(received)) == 0 &&
>           u32(in) == cols && u32(in) == rows, "grouped page header differs");
>     std::ofstream out(dest, std::ios::binary | std::ios::trunc);
>     check(bool(out), "grouped page output open failed");
>     write(out, encode ? frame_magic : raw_magic, sizeof(received));
>     u32(out, cols);
>     u32(out, rows);
>     for (size_t c = 0; c < cols; ++c) {
>         for (size_t start = 0; start < rows; start += corpus_rows) {
>             const size_t count = std::min(corpus_rows, rows - start);
>             const size_t n = u32(in);
>             check(encode ? n == count * width : n >= 16 && n <= corpus_max_frame, "grouped page record outside bounds");
>             Bytes raw(n);
>             read(in, raw.data(), n);
>             auto sink = [&](const Bytes &result) {
>                 check(encode ? result.size() >= 16 && result.size() <= corpus_max_frame : result.size() == count * width,
>                       "grouped page output extent differs");
>                 u32(out, result.size());
>                 write(out, result.data(), result.size());
>             };
>             if (encode) corpus_encode_bytes<Api>(raw, sink);
>             else corpus_decode_bytes<Api>(raw, sink);
>         }
>     }
>     check(in.peek() == std::char_traits<char>::eof() && in.eof() && !in.bad(), "trailing grouped page input");
>     out.close();
>     check(out.good(), "grouped page output close failed");
> }
> }
>
> int main(int argc, char **argv) {
>     try {
>         if (argc != 7) return 2;
>         const std::string_view op(argv[1]), lane(argv[2]);
>         if ((op != "encode" && op != "decode") || (lane != "source" && lane != "native")) return 2;
>         const auto cols = number(argv[3], max_columns), rows = number(argv[4], max_rows);
>         if (lane == "source") grouped<Source>(op == "encode", cols, rows, argv[5], argv[6]);
>         else grouped<Native>(op == "encode", cols, rows, argv[5], argv[6]);
>         return std::fflush(stdout) == 0 && !std::ferror(stdout) ? 0 : 3;
>     } catch (const std::exception &exc) {
>         std::fprintf(stderr, "pcodec grouped pages: %s\n", exc.what());
>         return 1;
>     }
> }

>
> ### pcodec 页：全值列计量驱动的分组 I/O 功能预检
>
> 新增 `native/measurement/pcodec_pages_grouped/`：在新构建目录内对冻结 r40 控制器的 I/O seam 应用 overlay，使用原 `libpcodec_c.so`。旧源文件和冻结控制程序不改。PGF1 只为隔离与测量把原文件的各列页组按顺序封装；不改变原 65,536 行/组、4,096 行/页、每组原生状态和 `PM3PAGE1` 产物，也不把不同页组当独立重复。该驱动可用一个进程完成一个文件—路线—方向，避免为每页组反复启动工具。
>
