> // Group I/O for the r40 Zstd dictionary route; each frame still uses the locked
> // feature worker's native stream helper, chunks, level and fresh context.
> #include "feature_io.hpp"
>
> #include <charconv>
> #include <chrono>
> #include <ctime>
> #include <filesystem>
> #include <fstream>
> #include <iostream>
> #include <string_view>
>
> namespace {
> using namespace lzbench_native;
> using feature_io::check;
> using clock_type = std::chrono::steady_clock;
> namespace fs = std::filesystem;
> constexpr size_t block = LN_MAX_BLOCK;
> constexpr size_t wire_limit = block + 1024;
> constexpr size_t holdout_limit = 512u << 20;
> constexpr size_t in_chunk = 307, out_chunk = 521;
> constexpr char magic[] = {'Z', 'D', 'G', '1'};
>
> size_t positive(std::string_view s, size_t ceiling) {
>     size_t n = 0;
>     auto r = std::from_chars(s.data(), s.data() + s.size(), n);
>     check(r.ec == std::errc{} && r.ptr == s.data() + s.size() && n && n <= ceiling, "invalid bounded size");
>     return n;
> }
>
> std::ifstream input(const char* path) {
>     std::ifstream f(path, std::ios::binary);
>     check(bool(f), "open input");
>     return f;
> }
>
> void read(std::istream& f, void* data, size_t n) {
>     check(bool(f.read(static_cast<char*>(data), static_cast<std::streamsize>(n))), "short or unreadable input");
> }
>
> bytes read(std::istream& f, size_t n) {
>     bytes b(n);
>     read(f, b.data(), n);
>     return b;
> }
>
> void end(std::istream& f) {
>     check(f.peek() == std::char_traits<char>::eof() && f.eof() && !f.bad(), "trailing or unreadable input");
> }
>
> void write(std::ostream& f, const void* data, size_t n) {
>     check(bool(f.write(static_cast<const char*>(data), static_cast<std::streamsize>(n))), "write output");
> }
>
> void word(std::ostream& f, uint32_t n) {
>     unsigned char b[4];
>     for (auto& v : b) { v = static_cast<unsigned char>(n); n >>= 8; }
>     write(f, b, sizeof b);
> }
>
> uint32_t u32(const unsigned char* b) {
>     uint32_t n = 0;
>     for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) n |= uint32_t(b[i]) << (8 * i);
>     return n;
> }
>
> uint32_t word(std::istream& f) {
>     unsigned char b[4];
>     read(f, b, sizeof b);
>     return u32(b);
> }
>
> class Output {
>     fs::path final_, partial_;
> public:
>     std::ofstream file;
>     explicit Output(const char* name) : final_(name), partial_(final_.string() + ".partial") {
>         check(!fs::exists(final_) && !fs::exists(partial_), "output exists");
>         file.open(partial_, std::ios::binary);
>         check(bool(file), "open output");
>     }
>     void publish() {
>         file.close();
>         check(bool(file), "close output");
>         fs::rename(partial_, final_);
>     }
>     ~Output() {
>         if (file.is_open()) file.close();
>         std::error_code ignored;
>         fs::remove(partial_, ignored);
>     }
> };
>
> uint32_t dictionary_id(const bytes& d) {
>     check(d.size() >= 8 && d.size() <= 2048 && u32(d.data()) == 0xec30a437 && u32(d.data() + 4) > 1,
>           "trained dictionary identity differs");
>     return u32(d.data() + 4);
> }
>
> bytes dictionary(const char* path) {
>     const auto n = fs::file_size(path);
>     check(n >= 8 && n <= 2048, "dictionary extent differs");
>     auto f = input(path);
>     auto d = read(f, n);
>     end(f);
>     return d;
> }
>
> struct Clocks {
>     uint64_t wall = 0, cpu = 0;
>     static uint64_t self_cpu() {
>         timespec t{};
>         check(clock_gettime(CLOCK_PROCESS_CPUTIME_ID, &t) == 0, "read process CPU clock");
>         return uint64_t(t.tv_sec) * 1000000000u + t.tv_nsec;
>     }
>     template<class Work> bytes measure(Work work) {
>         const auto c = self_cpu();
>         const auto a = clock_type::now();
>         auto result = work();
>         wall += std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::nanoseconds>(clock_type::now() - a).count();
>         cpu += self_cpu() - c;
>         return result;
>     }
>     void emit() const { std::cout << ",\"call_wall_ns\":" << wall << ",\"call_cpu_ns\":" << cpu; }
> };
>
> void train(const char* source, const char* dest, size_t cap, size_t each, size_t count) {
>     check(count >= 8 && ((cap == 256 && each == 32) || (cap == 2048 && each % 8 == 0 && count * each >= 8192)),
>           "training tier, alignment or sample population differs");
>     auto f = input(source);
>     std::vector<bytes> samples;
>     for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) samples.push_back(read(f, each));
>     end(f);
>     Clocks times;
>     auto d = times.measure([&] { return train_zstd_dictionary(samples, cap); });
>     auto id = dictionary_id(d);
>     check(d.size() <= cap, "dictionary capacity exceeded");
>     Output out(dest);
>     write(out.file, d.data(), d.size());
>     out.publish();
>     std::cout << "{\"operation\":\"train\",\"samples\":" << count << ",\"sample_bytes\":" << each
>               << ",\"input_bytes\":" << each * count << ",\"dictionary_id\":" << id
>               << ",\"dictionary_bytes\":" << d.size() << ",\"dictionary_capacity_bytes\":" << cap;
>     times.emit();
>     std::cout << "}\n";
> }
>
> void frames(bool encode, const char* source, const char* dest, const char* shared, size_t logical) {
>     configuration config;
>     config.codec = LN_ZSTD;
>     config.mode = "frame";
>     config.level = 3;
>     config.dictionary = dictionary(shared);
>     const auto id = dictionary_id(config.dictionary);
>     const auto count = (logical + block - 1) / block;
>     auto f = input(source);
>     Output out(dest);
>     if (encode) {
>         write(out.file, magic, sizeof magic);
>         word(out.file, static_cast<uint32_t>(count));
>     } else {
>         char head[sizeof magic];
>         read(f, head, sizeof head);
>         check(std::equal(std::begin(head), std::end(head), std::begin(magic)) && word(f) == count,
>               "ZDG1 header or frame count differs");
>     }
>     Clocks times;
>     size_t frame_bytes = 0;
>     reset_worker_stats();
>     for (size_t off = 0; off < logical; off += block) {
>         const auto n = std::min(block, logical - off);
>         auto size = n;
>         if (!encode) {
>             check(word(f) == n, "ZDG1 frame input extent differs");
>             size = word(f);
>             check(size && size <= wire_limit, "ZDG1 payload length out of bounds");
>         }
>         auto data = read(f, size);
>         auto result = times.measure([&] {
>             session s(config);
>             check(s.streaming() && s.configured().level == 3, "native Zstd frame route differs");
>             return encode ? feature_io::encode(s, data, in_chunk, out_chunk, block)
>                           : feature_io::decode(s, data, in_chunk, out_chunk, n);
>         });
>         if (encode) {
>             check(!result.empty() && result.size() <= wire_limit, "native Zstd frame exceeds harness bound");
>             word(out.file, static_cast<uint32_t>(n));
>             word(out.file, static_cast<uint32_t>(result.size()));
>         }
>         frame_bytes += encode ? result.size() : size;
>         write(out.file, result.data(), result.size());
>     }
>     end(f);
>     auto stats = get_worker_stats();
>     check(stats.worker_threads == 0, "unexpected background Zstd workers");
>     out.publish();
>     std::cout << "{\"operation\":\"" << (encode ? "encode" : "decode") << "\",\"logical_bytes\":" << logical
>               << ",\"native_frames\":" << count << ",\"native_frame_bytes\":" << frame_bytes
>               << ",\"wrapper_bytes\":" << 8 + 8 * count << ",\"dictionary_id\":" << id
>               << ",\"dictionary_bytes\":" << config.dictionary.size()
>               << ",\"worker_threads\":" << stats.worker_threads << ",\"jobs\":" << stats.jobs;
>     times.emit();
>     std::cout << "}\n";
> }
> }
>
> int main(int argc, char** argv) {

>         if (op == "train" && argc == 7)

>         else if ((op == "encode" || op == "decode") && argc == 6)

>         else throw std::runtime_error("usage: train input output capacity sample_bytes samples | encode/decode input output dictionary logical_bytes");
>         return 0;
>     } catch (const std::exception& error) {
>         std::cerr << error.what() << '\n';
>         return 2;
>     }
> }

> """Bounded ingress and ZDG1 validation for the r40 Zstd dictionary work.
>
> The controller sees the original to verify provenance. The trainer is a separate
> process and must receive only the staged prefix, not the source or the holdout.
> ZDG1 is harness framing, not native Zstd bytes; the dictionary is an external
> recovery dependency counted once per complete held-out archive.

> HEAD, FRAME = Struct('<4sI'), Struct('<II')
> MAGIC = b'ZDG1'
> MAX_WIRE = LIMIT + 1024
>

> def stage_inputs(root, item, entry, work, evidence, *, roles=('train', 'holdout')):

>     require(roles and len(set(roles)) == len(roles) and set(roles) <= {'train', 'holdout'},
>             'invalid dictionary staging roles')
>     spans, _, _ = extents(item, entry)
>     wanted = {
>         'train': {'bytes': spans[0][1] - spans[0][0], 'sha256': evidence['train_prefix_sha256']},
>         'holdout': evidence['holdout'],
>     }
>     require(wanted['holdout'] == {'bytes': spans[1][1] - spans[1][0],
>                                    'sha256': entry['partitions'][2]['canonical']['values_sha256']},
>             'dictionary held-out identity disagrees with the manifest')
>     scope = dict(zip(('train', 'holdout'), spans, strict=True))
>     width = entry['value_count'] * 8
>     staged = {}
>     try:
>         with ExitStack() as stack:
>             sinks, totals, digests = {}, dict.fromkeys(roles, 0), {k: sha256() for k in roles}
>             for role in roles:
>                 path = work / f'{role}.bin'
>                 sinks[role] = stack.enter_context(path.open('xb'))
>                 staged[role] = path
>             for batch in read_batches(root, entry):
>                 start = batch.start * width
>                 end = start + len(batch.values)
>                 for role, out in sinks.items():
>                     lo, hi = scope[role]
>                     if start < hi and lo < end:
>                         portion = memoryview(batch.values)[max(lo, start)-start:min(hi, end)-start]
>                         totals[role] += out.write(portion)
>                         digests[role].update(portion)
>         require(all({'bytes': totals[k], 'sha256': digests[k].hexdigest()} == wanted[k] for k in roles),
>                 'staged dictionary input differs from r40 evidence')
>     except BaseException:
>         for path in staged.values():
>             path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
>         raise
>     return staged
>

>
> ### Zstd 字典：分开训练、编码、恢复的分组 I/O 功能预检
>
> [`zstd_dictionary_grouped`](../../native/measurement/zstd_dictionary_grouped/) 是独立辅助构建，直接复用 r40 锁定的 `liblzbench_native.so` 和原 `feature_io.hpp`，不重编或替换历史插件。训练按冻结样本宽度把一个连续前缀拆成独立样本，调用同一训练入口；编码与恢复使用 level 3、307/521 字节流式缓冲，每 64 KiB 留出块各建一个新原生会话。一个方向只启动一个分组进程。`ZDG1` 是外层封装，不改变任何 Zstd 帧；完整恢复计费为原生帧字节 + `ZDG1` 字节 + 共享字典一次。
>
> [功能预检](../../tests/integration/zstd_dictionary_grouped.py) 使用 r40 的 ETTh1 标准档（128 个训练样本、3 帧）与 Dominick-1121 短训练档（21 个训练样本、1 帧）：两份字典以及全部四帧均与锁定旧程序和 r40 账本逐字节对账；删除留出原值和旧 roundtrip 输出后，使用 ZDG1 与字典复原全部位。两个输入各验证截断帧、尾随数据、缺字典、错字典、训练前缀尾随数据五个拒绝。该测试使用同一 ELF 运行闭包，但**不是** Bubblewrap 隔离试验或性能结果。
>
> 后续计时计划须从同一 r40 主账本冻结 **23 个文件、3,244,160 B 训练前缀、1,917 个完整留出帧 / 124,595,936 B 留出值**。宿主解析原件完成身份校验；训练 worker 只挂载前缀，编码只挂载留出值与固定字典，恢复只挂载固定 ZDG1 与固定字典，不挂载原件或训练样本。训练时间分列，不摊作编解码时间；阶段级耐久钟、分组工作钟、隔离进程资源与最终产物校验分别报告。缺少隔离重复、封账和独立复算前，不提高计量覆盖计数。

### 本轮完成
- **Gorilla C11 r2 已封账并独立复算。** [报告](./results/m3-gorilla-corpus-clock-20261120-r2/runs/3ec8705f65ae41a8b1f4cd9204f140bf/report.json)覆盖批量、续写、迭代三条路线，共 **192 次试验、448 个隔离操作**。批量使用 Unique 的 C11 原版，续写与迭代使用同源 C11 修复版，没有换成 C++ codec。
- **pcodec 已通过 ETTh1 断网文件隔离冒烟。** Gorilla 退出后才启动全量诊断；[运行账本](./results/m3-pcodec-grouped-timing-20261120-r1/runs/531ad64c81aa49ada337818241c6d2b5/trials.jsonl)已记录 **273/368 次**，尚未封账。
- **Zstd 字典路线新增分组驱动和分阶段隔离入口。** [功能预检](./tests/integration/zstd_dictionary_grouped.py)在两个真实输入上验证两份字典、四个原生帧与 r40 逐字节一致，并完整恢复留出值；相关 **6 项合同测试通过**。尚未执行真实隔离冒烟或计时。

### 总体进度
- **M0–M2 已验收，M3/M4 尚未验收。** Gorilla 新证据尚未登记到 [M3 计量清单 r3](./results/m3-real-r40-20261120/measurement-inventory-20261120-r3.json)。r40 的 CORAD 留出质量拒绝、PBEPLA-RR 原生失败和 ALP AVX512BW 本机待验均保留原结论。
- M4 代表性剖析和成本对照已完成复算，不用于填补 M3 的主计时缺口。

### 下一轮任务
1. 检查 pcodec 封账和独立复算，再将通过复算的 Gorilla、pcodec 证据登记到新版覆盖清单，不改写 r40 主账本。
2. pcodec 释放协作锁后，用 `tsbench` 执行 Zstd 字典的真实隔离冒烟，再冻结 23 文件的训练、编码和独立恢复计量计划。

> cat > native/measurement/zfp_field_grouped/main.cpp <<'EOF'
> // File grouping only: each whole f64 column is still a fresh r40 ZFP field.
> #include "zfp_native.h"
>
> #include <algorithm>
> #include <charconv>
> #include <chrono>
> #include <cstdint>
> #include <ctime>
> #include <filesystem>
> #include <fstream>
> #include <iostream>
> #include <memory>
> #include <stdexcept>
> #include <string_view>
> #include <vector>
>
> namespace {
> namespace fs = std::filesystem;
> using clock_type = std::chrono::steady_clock;
> using Field = std::unique_ptr<zn_context, decltype(&zn_destroy)>;
> constexpr size_t max_field_rows = (1u << 20) / sizeof(double);
> constexpr size_t max_field_frame = 4u << 20;
> constexpr unsigned chunk_blocks = 64;
> constexpr char magic[] = {'Z', 'F', 'G', '1'};
>
> void check(bool ok, const char* reason) { if (!ok) throw std::runtime_error(reason); }
> void native(zn_status rc) { if (rc != ZN_OK) throw std::runtime_error(zn_error(rc)); }
>
> size_t count(std::string_view text, size_t max) {
>     size_t n = 0;
>     auto end = text.data() + text.size();
>     auto r = std::from_chars(text.data(), end, n);
>     check(r.ec == std::errc{} && r.ptr == end && n && n <= max, "invalid field geometry");
>     return n;
> }
>
> void read(std::istream& f, void* p, size_t n) {
>     check(bool(f.read(static_cast<char*>(p), static_cast<std::streamsize>(n))), "truncated field input");
> }
> void write(std::ostream& f, const void* p, size_t n) {
>     check(bool(f.write(static_cast<const char*>(p), static_cast<std::streamsize>(n))), "failed writing field output");
> }
> uint32_t word(std::istream& f) {
>     unsigned char b[4]; read(f, b, sizeof b);
>     uint32_t n = 0;
>     for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) n |= uint32_t(b[i]) << (8*i);
>     return n;
> }
> void word(std::ostream& f, uint32_t n) {
>     unsigned char b[4];
>     for (auto& c : b) { c = static_cast<unsigned char>(n); n >>= 8; }
>     write(f, b, sizeof b);
> }
>
> class Product {
>     fs::path final_, partial_;
> public:
>     std::ofstream file;
>     explicit Product(const char* path) : final_(path), partial_(final_.string() + ".partial") {
>         check(!fs::exists(final_) && !fs::exists(partial_), "output already exists");
>         file.open(partial_, std::ios::binary);
>         check(bool(file), "cannot create field output");
>     }
>     void publish() {
>         file.close();
>         check(bool(file), "cannot close field output");
>         fs::rename(partial_, final_);
>     }
>     ~Product() {
>         if (file.is_open()) file.close();
>         std::error_code ignored;
>         fs::remove(partial_, ignored);
>     }
> };
>
> uint64_t cpu_ns() {
>     timespec t{};
>     check(clock_gettime(CLOCK_PROCESS_CPUTIME_ID, &t) == 0, "cannot read process CPU clock");
>     return uint64_t(t.tv_sec)*1000000000u + t.tv_nsec;
> }
>
> Field context(size_t n, std::string_view profile, zn_info& actual) {
>     const auto cfg = zn_config_1d(ZN_F64, n);
>     auto opts = zn_defaults();
>     if (profile != "serial") {
>         opts.execution = ZN_OPENMP;
>         opts.threads = profile == "omp1" ? 1 : 2;
>         opts.chunk_size = chunk_blocks;
>     }
>     zn_context* raw = nullptr;
>     auto status = zn_create_ex(&cfg, &opts, &raw);
>     Field obj(raw, zn_destroy);
>     native(status);
>     native(zn_get_info(raw, &actual));
>     check(actual.config.type == ZN_F64 && actual.config.dims == 1 && actual.config.mode == ZN_REVERSIBLE &&
>           actual.logical_bytes == n*sizeof(double) && actual.options.execution == opts.execution &&
>           actual.options.threads == opts.threads && actual.options.chunk_size == opts.chunk_size &&
>           actual.decode_execution == ZN_SERIAL, "unexpected native ZFP field configuration");
>     if (opts.execution == ZN_OPENMP)
>         check(actual.openmp_built == 1 && !actual.omp_dynamic && actual.omp_thread_limit == 2, "OpenMP runtime policy differs");
>     return obj;
> }
>
> void run(bool encode, std::string_view profile, size_t columns, size_t rows, const char* in, const char* out) {
>     const size_t logical = rows*sizeof(double);
>     check(columns*logical <= (128u << 20), "whole field input exceeds file ceiling");
>     std::ifstream input(in, std::ios::binary);
>     check(bool(input), "cannot open field input");
>     Product product(out);
>     if (encode) {
>         write(product.file, magic, sizeof magic);
>         word(product.file, static_cast<uint32_t>(columns));
>         word(product.file, static_cast<uint32_t>(rows));
>     } else {
>         char header[sizeof magic]; read(input, header, sizeof header);
>         check(std::equal(std::begin(header), std::end(header), std::begin(magic)) && word(input) == columns && word(input) == rows,
>               "ZFG1 header geometry differs");
>     }
>     // Read values/frames before the native window; publish outside it. Per-field
>     // configure and teardown are outside the encode/decode API clock as well.
>     for (size_t c = 0; c < columns; ++c) {
>         std::vector<double> values(rows);
>         std::vector<unsigned char> frame;
>         size_t used = 0;
>         if (encode) {
>             read(input, values.data(), logical);
>         } else {
>             used = word(input);
>             check(used && used <= max_field_frame && used % 8 == 0, "invalid ZFG1 frame length");
>             frame.resize(used);
>             read(input, frame.data(), used);
>         }
>         zn_info actual{};
>         const auto field = context(rows, profile, actual);
>         const auto cpu0 = cpu_ns();
>         const auto wall0 = clock_type::now();
>         const auto status = encode ? zn_encode_field(field.get(), values.data(), logical, 0, &used)
>                                    : zn_decode_field(field.get(), frame.data(), used, values.data(), logical, 0);
>         const auto wall = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::nanoseconds>(clock_type::now() - wall0).count();
>         const auto cpu = cpu_ns() - cpu0;
>         native(status);
>         check(used && used <= max_field_frame && used % 8 == 0, "unexpected ZFP frame bytes");
>         if (encode) {
>             word(product.file, static_cast<uint32_t>(used));
>             write(product.file, zn_data(field.get()), used);
>         } else {
>             write(product.file, values.data(), logical);
>         }
>         std::cout << "{\"column\":" << c << ",\"rows\":" << rows << ",\"frame_bytes\":" << used
>                   << ",\"execution\":" << actual.options.execution << ",\"configured_threads\":" << actual.options.threads
>                   << ",\"chunk_blocks\":" << actual.options.chunk_size << ",\"decode_execution\":" << actual.decode_execution
>                   << ",\"call_wall_ns\":" << wall << ",\"call_cpu_ns\":" << cpu << "}\n";
>     }
>     check(input.peek() == std::char_traits<char>::eof() && input.eof() && !input.bad(), "trailing or unreadable field input");
>     product.publish();
> }
> }
>
> int main(int argc, char** argv) {
>     try {
>         check(argc == 7, "usage: encode/decode serial/omp1/omp2 columns rows in out");
>         const std::string_view op(argv[1]), profile(argv[2]);
>         check((op == "encode" || op == "decode") && (profile == "serial" || profile == "omp1" || profile == "omp2") &&
>               (op != "decode" || profile == "serial"), "invalid ZFP field operation or profile");
>         run(op == "encode", profile, count(argv[3], 4096), count(argv[4], max_field_rows), argv[5], argv[6]);
>         return 0;
>     } catch (const std::exception& e) {
>         std::cerr << e.what() << '\n';
>         return 2;
>     }
> }

>
> namespace {
> struct Work { size_t full = 0, tail = 0; };
> std::mutex mutex;
> std::map<long, Work> workers;
> thread_local unsigned depth = 0;
>
> class Mark {
> public:
>     explicit Mark(bool tail) {
>         if (depth++ == 0) {
>             static thread_local const long tid = syscall(SYS_gettid);
>             const std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex);
>             auto& w = workers[tid];
>             if (tail) ++w.tail;
>             else ++w.full;
>         }
>     }
>     ~Mark() { --depth; }
> };
>
> template<class F> F symbol(const char* name) {
>     auto fn = reinterpret_cast<F>(dlsym(RTLD_NEXT, name));
>     if (!fn) std::abort();
>     return fn;
> }
> }
>
> void zfp_clear_work_marks() {
>     const std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex);

> constexpr uint32_t requested_rate = 18, effective_rate = 32;

> void check(bool ok, const char* reason) { if (!ok) throw std::runtime_error(reason); }
> void native(zn_status code) { if (code != ZN_OK) throw std::runtime_error(zn_error(code)); }
> void read(std::istream& f, void* ptr, size_t n) {
>     check(bool(f.read(static_cast<char*>(ptr), static_cast<std::streamsize>(n))), "truncated grouped array input");
> }
> void write(std::ostream& f, const void* ptr, size_t n) {
>     check(bool(f.write(static_cast<const char*>(ptr), static_cast<std::streamsize>(n))), "grouped array output write failed");
> }
> uint32_t word(std::istream& f) {
>     uint8_t buf[4];
>     read(f, buf, sizeof buf);
>     uint32_t n = 0;
>     for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; ++i) n |= uint32_t(buf[i]) << (8*i);
>     return n;
> }
> void word(std::ostream& f, uint32_t n) {
>     uint8_t buf[4];
>     for (auto& v : buf) { v = static_cast<uint8_t>(n); n >>= 8; }
>     write(f, buf, sizeof buf);
> }
>
> class Product {
>     fs::path path_, scratch_;
>     bool published_ = false, accepted_ = false;
> public:
>     std::ofstream file;
>     explicit Product(const char* path) : path_(path), scratch_(path_.string()+".partial") {
>         check(!fs::exists(path_) && !fs::exists(scratch_), "array output already exists");
>         file.open(scratch_, std::ios::binary);
>         check(bool(file), "array output open failed");
>     }
>     void publish() {
>         file.close();
>         check(bool(file), "array output close failed");
>         fs::rename(scratch_, path_);
>         published_ = true;
>     }
>     void accept() noexcept { accepted_ = true; }
>     ~Product() {
>         if (file.is_open()) file.close();
>         std::error_code ignored;
>         if (published_ && !accepted_) fs::remove(path_, ignored);
>         if (!published_) fs::remove(scratch_, ignored);
>     }
> };

> struct Extent { uint32_t windows, columns, rows; };
> struct Window { uint32_t column, start, rows; };
>
> Extent extent(std::istream& f, std::string_view kind) {
>     char head[4];
>     read(f, head, sizeof head);
>     check(std::string_view(head, sizeof head) == kind, "grouped array input identity differs");
>     Extent e{word(f), word(f), word(f)};
>     check(e.windows && e.windows <= 25000 && e.columns && e.columns <= 4096 && e.rows >= 8 && e.rows <= 131072 &&
>           uint64_t(e.columns)*e.rows*sizeof(double) <= (128u<<20), "grouped array input extent differs");
>     if (kind == wire_magic)
>         check(word(f) == requested_rate && word(f) == effective_rate, "grouped array wire rate differs");
>     return e;
> }
> void header(std::ostream& f, std::string_view kind, Extent e) {
>     write(f, kind.data(), kind.size());
>     word(f, e.windows); word(f, e.columns); word(f, e.rows);
>     if (kind == wire_magic) { word(f, requested_rate); word(f, effective_rate); }
> }
> void geometry(std::ostream& f, Window w) { word(f, w.column); word(f, w.start); word(f, w.rows); }
> Window geometry(std::istream& f, Extent e, Window prior, uint32_t index) {
>     Window w{word(f), word(f), word(f)};
>     check(w.column < e.columns && w.rows >= 8 && w.rows <= 4096 && w.start < e.rows && w.rows <= e.rows-w.start &&
>           (index == 0 || w.column > prior.column || (w.column == prior.column && w.start >= prior.start + prior.rows)),
>           "grouped array window is out of range, overlaps, or is unordered");
>     return w;
> }
>
> uint64_t cpu_ns() {
>     timespec ts{};
>     check(clock_gettime(CLOCK_PROCESS_CPUTIME_ID, &ts) == 0, "cannot observe array CPU time");
>     return uint64_t(ts.tv_sec)*1000000000u + ts.tv_nsec;
> }
> struct Span {
>     uint64_t cpu_start = cpu_ns();
>     Clock::time_point wall_start = Clock::now();
>     uint64_t wall = 0, cpu = 0;
>     void stop() {
>         wall = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::nanoseconds>(Clock::now()-wall_start).count();
>         cpu = cpu_ns()-cpu_start;
>     }
>     void emit(const char* name) const {

> }

> void update(std::istream& input, Extent e, Product& initial, Product& changed) {
>     header(initial.file, wire_magic, e);
>     header(changed.file, wire_magic, e);

>         const auto status = zn_array_create(&cfg, values.data(), logical, &pointer);
>         create.stop();
>         Array a(pointer, zn_array_destroy);
>         native(status);
>         identity(a.get(), w, bytes);
>         Span before;

>         geometry(changed.file, w);
>         write(changed.file, modified.data(), modified.size());
>         report(w, bytes);
>         create.emit("create"); before.emit("initial_export"); mutate.emit("point_range_flush"); after.emit("updated_export");

>     }

> [独立观测程序](../../native/measurement/zfp_field_grouped/observe.cpp) 在另一二进制中统计相同可逆工作实际执行完整块与尾块的 TID；不输出计时数据、不进入原生或耐久分布。必须核对与不插桩路径相同的帧及恢复位，按列验证块数及尾块，不从线程创建或 runtime 请求推断参与线程。[真实隔离冒烟](../../tests/isolation/zfp_field_grouped_smoke.py) 在 ETTh1（7 列 × 17,420 行）和 Dominick-1121（1 列 × 142 行）完成 **20 个方向路径和 12 个独立观测**：OpenMP 2 的 ETTh1 每列观察到两个参与线程，短列仅一个。全量计划包含 920 个方向试验和 138 个对应的独立观测操作；未封账及复算时不登记覆盖。
>

### 本轮完成
- **Zstd 字典诊断已封账并独立复算**：23 个文件、1,917 个留出帧，训练、编码、独立恢复共 276 次试验。纳入[覆盖清单 r5](./results/m3-real-r40-20261120/measurement-inventory-20261120-r5.json)后，完整范围的原生重复覆盖增至 **327** 个决定，验证后耐久重复增至 **225** 个决定。

- **ZFP 固定速率数组分组驱动通过功能预检**：4 个冻结窗口的初始帧、更新帧与独立重开结果均和旧控制器逐字节一致；Bitcoin-1 首窗仍是初始通过、更新后质量拒绝，未放宽门槛。[预检](./tests/integration/zfp_array_grouped.py)

### 本轮完成
- **ZFP 固定速率数组计量计划已冻结**，覆盖 23 个文件、20,520 个窗口，分别执行更新、初始归档独立重开、更新归档独立重开，共 276 次计划试验。保留 r40 中 6 个文件、26 个窗口的质量拒绝；这些文件仍会实跑，但不计入通过覆盖。[冻结计划](./results/m3-zfp-array-timing-20261120-r1/plan.json)
- 数组隔离入口、逐窗验证和覆盖审计共 **10 项合同测试通过**。真实隔离冒烟和全量运行已排队，须等可逆整列运行封账并复算后才启动。
- **ZFP 可逆整列**继续使用原运行账本，已记录 **330/920** 次试验，尚未封账。[运行账本](./results/m3-zfp-field-timing-20261120-r1/runs/98124ddf0cec4b5182ec75c7bcf29d85/trials.jsonl)

### 总体进度
**M0–M2 已验收，M3/M4 尚未验收。** 已封账的[覆盖清单 r5](./results/m3-real-r40-20261120/measurement-inventory-20261120-r5.json)仍为 **327 个**完整范围原生重复、**225 个**完整范围验证后耐久重复。未封账的 ZFP 证据不计入覆盖，r40 主账本未改写。

### 下一轮任务
1. 检查可逆整列封账及独立复算，并确认数组真实隔离冒烟是否通过、全量运行是否启动。

- **ZFP 固定速率数组**：通过真实隔离冒烟，已启动全量试验；最后查看时已记录 **72/276** 次，尚未封账。[运行账本](./results/m3-zfp-array-timing-20261120-r1/runs/884e3af373a84f06856b9f77ea20f412/trials.jsonl)
- **M4 成本报告**：发布并复算了 [v2 报告](./results/m4-real-profile-20261120-r4/cost-comparison-20261120-r2.json)，关联 1,008 次多尺度 ABI 方向试验。修正为「未声明重叠」，不等同于主机独占；不同计时边界不相减。13 项合同测试通过，历史报告未改写。

### 总体进度
**M0–M2 已验收，M3 和 M4 尚未验收。** [覆盖清单 r6](./results/m3-real-r40-20261120/measurement-inventory-20261120-r6.json) 已复算：396 个决定有完整范围的原生重复计量，151 个仅有投影或留样计量，294 个有完整范围的验证后耐久重复计量。r40 主账本的 828 个决定及正式资格均未改变。

>
> ### ALP 与 Titchy 原生批路径：从留样扩展到全列窗口
>
> [完整输入与固定帧清单](../../results/m3-column-batch-20261120-r2/population.json) 从同一 r40 封印锁定 `auto-batch`、`decode-backends`、Titchy `batch` 三路线各 **23 文件 × 2,751 值列窗口**，保留 65,536 行上限；I/O 组只约束单个文件尺寸，不改变帧或上下文边界。复用冻结 DSO：ALP 编码为 Auto，`decode-backends` 的 scalar-unfused 与 FALP auto 共用完全相同的固定帧；逐轮对账实际分派与向量计数，不把 FALP auto 当作 AVX512BW 实测。Titchy 批按原合同位转为 u64，独立恢复后核对包括负零在内的原位。原生帧、ABI 包装分别计费，不把分组预备写头当成压缩帧。
>
> [真实隔离冒烟](../../results/m3-column-batch-20261120-r2/smoke.json) 用 ETTm2 的含尾窗 ALP 两路线及 ETTh1 的 Titchy 批共 7 个方向验证固定帧、输出原位和实际后端。首个计量预检的报告因误用只接受整数的分布函数而未封账；修正后另冻 [r3 ETTh1 预检](../../results/m3-column-batch-20261120-r3/preflight-runs/b06bb4ef0f424bb3bb3083e2a0e0a7aa/report.json)，28 次方向试验全部封账并复算。[r3 完整计量计划](../../results/m3-column-batch-20261120-r3/plan.json) 按文件/方向用相同 CPU、一次预热和三次独立进程重复，合计 **644** 次。编码耐久钟从锁定原件重新解析开始，解码只挂载固定帧组，两者截至验证和文件/目录同步；ABI、上下文创建、隔离进程和耐久时钟分列。没有系统独占，也不把 Titchy 批处理计作包流或访问机制证据。全量只有封账并复算后可用 `--evidence column-batch RUN` 更新覆盖清单。

> namespace {
> using Entry = int (*)(int,char**);
> void need(bool condition,const char *message) {
>     if (!condition) throw std::runtime_error(message);
> }
> size_t bounded(std::string_view s,size_t max) {
>     size_t n{};
>     const auto end=s.data()+s.size();
>     const auto r=std::from_chars(s.data(),end,n);
>     need(r.ec==std::errc{} && r.ptr==end && n && n<=max,"invalid grouped Titchy extent");
>     return n;
> }
> void unit(Entry entry,std::vector<std::string> args) {
>     std::vector<char*> argv;
>     argv.reserve(args.size()+1);
>     for (auto &s:args) argv.push_back(s.data());
>     argv.push_back(nullptr);
>     need(entry(static_cast<int>(args.size()),argv.data())==0,"Titchy unit rejected; no measurements admitted");
> }
> std::string basename(size_t i) {
>     std::ostringstream out;

>     return out.str();
> }
> }

> cat > native/measurement/pbepla_grouped/main.cpp <<'EOF'
> // Native call boundaries for the unchanged r40 PBEP controller. Applies only
> // to calls made by this executable; it does not modify or instrument the DSO.
> #include "tba.h"
> #include <array>
> #include <charconv>
> #include <chrono>
> #include <filesystem>
> #include <iostream>
> #include <sched.h>
> #include <stdexcept>
> #include <string_view>
>
> int tsbench_pbepla_corpus_unit(int argc, char **argv);
>
> namespace {
> using Clock = std::chrono::steady_clock;
> static_assert(Clock::is_steady);
> struct Sample { const char *part; unsigned layer; int result; uint64_t ns; };
> std::array<Sample,8> samples;
> size_t used=0;
> void need(bool ok,const char *reason) {
>     if (!ok) throw std::runtime_error(reason);
> }
> template<class F> int profile(const char *part,unsigned layer,F fn) {
>     need(used<samples.size(),"too many PBEPLA calls from frozen corpus controller");
>     const auto start=Clock::now();
>     const int rc=fn();
>     const auto elapsed=std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::nanoseconds>(Clock::now()-start).count();
>     samples[used++]={part,layer,rc,static_cast<uint64_t>(elapsed)};
>     return rc;
> }
> void emit(size_t index) {
>     std::cout<<"{\"index\":"<<index<<",\"native_calls\":[";
>     for (size_t i=0;i<used;++i) {
>         const auto &r=samples[i];
>         std::cout<<(i ? "," : "")<<"{\"part\":\""<<r.part<<"\",\"layer\":"<<r.layer
>                  <<",\"result\":"<<r.result<<",\"wall_ns\":"<<r.ns<<'}';
>     }
>     std::cout<<"]}\n";
> }
> }
>
> extern "C" {
> decltype(tba_pbepla_encode_ex) __real_tba_pbepla_encode_ex;
> decltype(tba_pbepla_encode_stream) __real_tba_pbepla_encode_stream;
> decltype(tba_pbepla_prefix) __real_tba_pbepla_prefix;
> decltype(tba_pbepla_inspect) __real_tba_pbepla_inspect;
> decltype(tba_decode) __real_tba_decode;
> decltype(tba_pbepla_decode_stream) __real_tba_pbepla_decode_stream;
>
> int __wrap_tba_pbepla_encode_ex(const double *p,size_t n,const tba_pbepla_options *o,tba_pbepla_info *info,
>                               tba_buffer *b,char *e,size_t cap) {
>     return profile("batch_encode",0,[&]{return __real_tba_pbepla_encode_ex(p,n,o,info,b,e,cap);});
> }
> int __wrap_tba_pbepla_encode_stream(void *src,tba_rewind_fn rewind,tba_next_fn next,void *sink,tba_write_fn writer,
>                                   const tba_pbepla_options *o,size_t n,tba_stream_stats *stats,char *e,size_t cap) {
>     return profile("replay_encode",0,[&]{return __real_tba_pbepla_encode_stream(src,rewind,next,sink,writer,o,n,stats,e,cap);});
> }
> int __wrap_tba_pbepla_prefix(const void *p,size_t n,unsigned layer,tba_buffer *b,char *e,size_t cap) {
>     return profile("prefix_materialize",layer,[&]{return __real_tba_pbepla_prefix(p,n,layer,b,e,cap);});
> }
> int __wrap_tba_pbepla_inspect(const void *p,size_t n,tba_pbepla_info *i,char *e,size_t cap) {
>     return profile("detached_prefix_inspect",0,[&]{return __real_tba_pbepla_inspect(p,n,i,e,cap);});
> }
> int __wrap_tba_decode(int32_t kind,const void *p,size_t n,unsigned layer,size_t max,tba_buffer *b,char *e,size_t cap) {
>     return profile("batch_restore",layer,[&]{return __real_tba_decode(kind,p,n,layer,max,b,e,cap);});
> }
> int __wrap_tba_pbepla_decode_stream(const void *p,size_t n,unsigned layer,size_t max,void *sink,tba_emit_fn fn,char *e,size_t cap) {
>     return profile("callback_restore",layer,[&]{return __real_tba_pbepla_decode_stream(p,n,layer,max,sink,fn,e,cap);});
> }
> }
>
> int main(int argc,char **argv) {
>     try {
>         need(argc>=3,"expected bounded progressive/replay group or detached prefix group");
>         const std::string_view op=argv[1];
>         const bool dec=op=="restore-batch" || op=="restore-callback";
>         need(dec || op=="progressive" || op=="replay","unknown PBEPLA operation");
>         const int first=dec ? 3 : 2;
>         need(first<argc && argc-first<=32,"PBEPLA group must have 1--32 units");
>         need(!dec || (std::string_view(argv[2]).size()==1 && argv[2][0]>='1' && argv[2][0]<='3'),"invalid layer");
>         std::array<size_t,32> ids{};
>         uint64_t mask=0;
>         for (int i=first;i<argc;++i) {
>             const std::string_view s=argv[i];
>             const auto r=std::from_chars(s.data(),s.data()+s.size(),ids[i-first]);
>             const size_t ix=ids[i-first];
>             need(r.ec==std::errc{} && r.ptr==s.data()+s.size() && ix<32 && !(mask&(uint64_t(1)<<ix)),"invalid PBEPLA unit");
>             mask|=uint64_t(1)<<ix;
>         }
>         namespace fs=std::filesystem;
>         const fs::path work="/tmp/tsbench-pbepla-group";
>         need(fs::create_directory(work),"group working directory already exists");
>         fs::create_directory_symlink("/inputs",work/"input");
>         fs::create_directory_symlink("/out",work/"out");
>         fs::current_path(work);
>         const int before=sched_getcpu();
>         for (int i=first;i<argc;++i) {
>             used=0;
>             char *args[]{argv[0],argv[1],dec ? argv[2] : argv[i],dec ? argv[i] : nullptr,nullptr};
>             need(tsbench_pbepla_corpus_unit(first+1,args)==0,"PBEPLA call group failed");
>             emit(ids[i-first]);
>         }
>         std::cout<<"{\"units\":"<<argc-first<<",\"cpu_endpoints\":["<<before<<','<<sched_getcpu()<<"]}\n";
>         return std::cout.good() ? 0 : 2;
>     } catch (const std::exception &error) {
>         std::cerr<<"PBEPLA group: "<<error.what()<<'\n';
>         return 2;
>     }
> }

> CODE = ('src/tsbench/application/m3_pbepla_grouped_timing.py', 'tools/m3_pbepla_grouped_timing.py',
>         'src/tsbench/application/m3_column_batch_timing.py', 'src/tsbench/supervisor/timing_resource.py')
> POLICY = {'seed':119781, 'warmups':1, 'measured_rounds':3, 'group_max_windows':GROUP,
>           'sampling':'independent file/route/phase rounds with a fresh isolated process per bounded internal group; groups not replicates',
>           'encoding_replay_control':'batch comparison from same window timed separately, not charged to native replay',
>           'restore':'one fixed exact prefix per window in each detached session; original only available to host validator',
>           'durable':'original source parse or immutable prefix archive through product verification and sync of grouped output and directory',
>           'archive':'experiment pack has 8-byte ordinal and extent per record; native compression accounting excludes the pack; layers stand alone',
>           'failed_files':'keep actual failure and partial coverage; missing prefixes skip decode explicitly; no admitted summaries from failed files',
>           'cache':'inherited, not cold', 'reservation':resource.RESERVATION, 'exclusive_cpu':False,
>           'stage_accepted':False, 'timing_admitted':False, 'qualification_granted':False}

> def freeze(root, pop_path, cpu, datasets=()):
>     pop = load_json(pop_path)
>     _id(pop,'population_id')
>     require(pop['schema']==POP and pop['launchers']==launcher_lock() and
>             all(digest(local_file(root,k))==h for k,h in pop['code'].items()),'PBEPLA population contract changed')
>     require(len(set(datasets))==len(datasets) and set(datasets)<={c['dataset_id'] for c in pop['cases']},'unknown PBEPLA projection')
>     body = {'schema':SCHEMA,'population':relative(root,pop_path),'population_id':pop['population_id'],
>             'source_plan':pop['source_plan'],'source_seal':pop['source_seal'],'dataset_projection':sorted(datasets) or None,
>             'policy':POLICY,'environment':resource.environment(cpu),'code':{k:digest(local_file(root,k)) for k in CODE}}
>     return {**body,'plan_content_id':content_id(body)}
>

> def _cases(pop,plan):
>     return [c for c in pop['cases'] if plan['dataset_projection'] is None or c['dataset_id'] in plan['dataset_projection']]
>
>
> def schedule(case):
>     rng = Random(POLICY['seed'] ^ int(case['case_id'][:16],16))
>     for r in range(POLICY['warmups']+POLICY['measured_rounds']):
>         for op in rng.sample(OPERATIONS,len(OPERATIONS)):
>             yield {'operation':op,'round':r,'phase':'warmup' if r==0 else 'measured'}
>
>
> def groups(case, layer=None):
>     """Return original file-local IDs even when failed windows have no prefix."""
>     rows = [(i,u) for i,u in enumerate(case['units']) if layer is None or u['status']!='failed']
>     for start in range(0,len(rows),GROUP):
>         yield rows[start:start+GROUP]
>
>
> def _parts(case, layer=None, restored=False):
>     for i,u in enumerate(case['units']):
>         if layer is None:
>             yield i,{'bytes':u['logical_input_bytes'],'sha256':u['input_sha256']}
>         elif u['status'] != 'failed':
>             t = u['layers'][layer-1]
>             yield i,{'bytes':u['logical_input_bytes'] if restored else t['bytes'],
>                      'sha256':t['restored_sha256' if restored else 'frame_sha256']}
>
>
> def _append(stream, i, payload):
>     stream.write(RECORD.pack(i,len(payload)))
>     stream.write(payload)
>
>
> def _read_pack(path, expected):
>     with path.open('rb') as f:
>         for i,identity in expected:
>             h = f.read(RECORD.size)
>             require(len(h)==RECORD.size and RECORD.unpack(h)==(i,identity['bytes']),'PBEPLA packed frame length or ordinal differs')
>             raw = f.read(identity['bytes'])
>             require(br(raw)==identity,'PBEPLA packed bytes differ from r40 identity')
>             yield raw
>         require(not f.read(1),'unexpected trailing PBEPLA pack bytes')
>
>
> def _mode(case, layer):
>     replay = case['route']==REPLAY
>     return ('replay' if replay else 'progressive') if layer is None else ('restore-callback' if replay else 'restore-batch')
>

> def _run_worker(run,pop,cpu,mode,layer,inputs,work):
>     work.mkdir()
>     indexes = [name if layer is None else name.split('-',1)[0] for name in inputs]
>     argv = [mode,*([str(layer)] if layer is not None else []),*indexes]
>     out,proc = invoke_isolated_tool(run/'runtime',pop['runtime'],TOOL,pop['limits'],work,work,mode,inputs,argv,lambda:False,
>                                     observe=True,file_ceiling=pop['limits']['file_bytes'],private_tmp=True)
>     stdout,stderr = (work/(mode+'.'+ext) for ext in ('stdout','stderr'))
>     require(proc['status']=='completed' and proc['returncode']==0 and not stderr.stat().st_size,
>             f'PBEPLA {mode}: {proc["status"]}: {stderr.read_text()[:300]}')
>     lines = [parse_json(row,'PBEPLA grouped worker') for row in stdout.read_text().splitlines()]
>     require(len(lines)==2*len(inputs)+1 and lines[-1]=={'units':len(inputs),'cpu_endpoints':[cpu]*2},
>             'PBEPLA isolated group did not cover planned units/CPU')
>     return out,{'process':proc,'cpu_endpoints':lines[-1]['cpu_endpoints'],'observations':[
>         {'result':a,'clock':b} for a,b in zip(lines[:-1:2],lines[1:-1:2],strict=True)]}
>

> def _names(units, layer=None, inputs=False):
>     if inputs:
>         for j,(i,u) in enumerate(units):
>             field = {'bytes':u['logical_input_bytes'],'sha256':u['input_sha256']} if layer is None else {
>                 'bytes':u['layers'][layer-1]['bytes'],'sha256':u['layers'][layer-1]['frame_sha256']}
>             yield str(j) if layer is None else f'{j}-{layer}', i, field
>     else:
>         for j,(i,u) in enumerate(units):
>             if u['status']=='failed':
>                 continue
>             if layer is None:
>                 for k,t in enumerate(u['layers'],1):
>                     yield f'{j}-{k}',i,{'bytes':t['bytes'],'sha256':t['frame_sha256']}
>             else:
>                 yield f'{j}-{layer}',i,{'bytes':u['logical_input_bytes'],'sha256':u['layers'][layer-1]['restored_sha256']}
>

> def _record(case, units, layer, row, cpu, seen):
>     mode, replay = _mode(case,layer), case['route']==REPLAY
>     proc = row['process']
>     expected_in = {n:v for n,_,v in _names(units,layer,True)}
>     expected_out = {n:v for n,_,v in _names(units,layer)}
>     require(row['indices']==[i for i,_ in units] and row['cpu_endpoints']==[cpu]*2 and proc['input_mounts']==expected_in and
>             row['outputs']==expected_out and proc['operation']==mode and proc['status']=='completed' and proc['returncode']==0 and
>             not proc['reason'] and proc['pid']>0 and proc['session_id'] and proc['session_id'] not in seen and
>             proc['child_usage']['maxrss_bytes']>0 and len(row['observations'])==len(units),'PBEPLA group status/scope differs')
>     seen.add(proc['session_id'])
>     tally, sink = Counter(), []
>     for j,((_,u),e) in enumerate(zip(units,row['observations'],strict=True)):
>         obs, doc = e['result'],e['clock']
>         calls = doc['native_calls']
>         require(obs['index']==doc['index']==j and all(type(x['wall_ns']) is int and x['wall_ns']>0 and
>                     type(x['result']) is int for x in calls),'PBEPLA native clock census differs')
>         if layer is not None:
>             wanted = [('detached_prefix_inspect',0),('callback_restore' if replay else 'batch_restore',layer)]
>             require(obs=={'index':j,'status':'restored','layer':layer},'PBEPLA detached prefix was not restored')
>         elif u['status']=='failed':
>             wanted = [('replay_encode' if replay else 'batch_encode',0)]
>             require(obs=={'index':j,'status':'failed','reason':u['reason']},'PBEPLA failure changed or got a synthetic prefix')
>         else:
>             wanted = ([('replay_encode',0)] if replay else [])+[('batch_encode',0)]+[('prefix_materialize',k) for k in LAYERS]
>             require(obs['status']=='encoded' and obs['rows']*8==u['logical_input_bytes'] and
>                     obs['native_full_bytes']==u['layers'][-1]['bytes'],'PBEPLA generated different output')
>             io = obs['replay']
>             require(({k:v for k,v in io.items() if k!='first_sink_ns'} if io else None)==u['replay'],'PBEPLA actual replay work differs')
>             if replay:
>                 require(type(io['first_sink_ns']) is int and 0<io['first_sink_ns']<=proc['process_wall_ns'],'PBEPLA first sink was not observed')
>                 sink.append(io['first_sink_ns'])
>         rejected = layer is None and u['status']=='failed'
>         require([(a['part'],a['layer']) for a in calls]==wanted and all((a['result']!=0)==rejected for a in calls),
>                 'PBEPLA native phase or exit status differs')
>         for a in calls:
>             category = a['part']
>             if rejected:
>                 category = 'failed_'+category
>             if replay and category=='batch_encode':
>                 category = 'batch_validation_control'
>             if category=='prefix_materialize':
>                 category += '_L'+str(a['layer'])
>             tally[category]+=a['wall_ns']
>     require(0<sum(tally.values())<=proc['process_wall_ns'],'PBEPLA native phase clocks overlap or exceed group time')
>     return tally,sink

> def _flush(streams, head):
>     for f in streams:
>         f.flush()
>         os.fsync(f.fileno())
>     fd = os.open(head,os.O_RDONLY|os.O_DIRECTORY)
>     try:
>         os.fsync(fd)
>     finally:
>         os.close(fd)

> def _drive(run,pop,case,layer,cpu,dest,values,streams,seen):
>     mode = _mode(case,layer)
>     result = []
>     dest.mkdir()
>     for group in groups(case,layer):
>         with TemporaryDirectory(prefix='group-',dir=dest) as tmp:
>             work = Path(tmp)
>             inputs = {}
>             for name,_,identity in _names(group,layer,True):
>                 data = next(values,b'')
>                 require(br(data)==identity,'PBEPLA group original/prefix identity differs before launch')
>                 p = work/name
>                 p.write_bytes(data)
>                 inputs[name] = p
>             out,row = _run_worker(run,pop,cpu,mode,layer,inputs,work/'call')
>             expected = list(_names(group,layer))
>             require({p.name for p in out.iterdir()}=={n for n,_,_ in expected},'PBEPLA unexpected or missing product')
>             row['outputs'],row['indices'] = {},[i for i,_ in group]
>             for name,i,_ in expected:
>                 wire = local_file(out,name).read_bytes()
>                 row['outputs'][name] = br(wire)
>                 target = int(name.split('-')[1]) if layer is None else layer
>                 _append(streams[target],i,wire)
>             _record(case,group,layer,row,cpu,seen)
>             result.append(row)
>     require(next(values,None) is None,'PBEPLA file execution left unconsumed unit data')
>     return result

> def _source(root, entry, pair, case, work):

> def _trial(root,run,pop,case,entry,pair,anchor,cpu,t,seen):

>     layer = None if op=='encode' else int(op[-1])
>     flag = layer is not None and not any(u['status']!='failed' for u in case['units'])

> def _native_runs(root, plan):
>     runs = {}
>     for kind, binding in plan['sources'].items():
>         seal = check(root, binding['seal'])
>         require(seal.name == 'completion.json', 'foreign native seal')
>         runs[kind] = seal.parent
>     return runs
>
>
> def freeze(root, runs, cpu, dataset=None):
>     require(runs.keys() == DRIVERS.keys(), 'requires both native reference runs')
>     sources, cases, terms = {}, [], []
>     plan_ref = source_run = source_seal = None
>     for kind, driver in DRIVERS.items():
>         run = runs[kind]
>         baseline_file = local_file(run, 'plan.json')
>         baseline = load_json(baseline_file)
>         report = local_file(run, 'report.json')
>         require(driver.verify(run) == load_json(report), 'native reference report fails recomputation')
>         ref, run_dir, seal = (baseline[k] for k in ('source_plan', 'source_run', 'source_seal'))
>         if plan_ref is None:
>             plan_ref, source_run, source_seal = ref, run_dir, seal
>         require((ref, run_dir, seal) == (plan_ref, source_run, source_seal), 'native references do not share one functional seal')
>         source = (root / run_dir).resolve(strict=True)
>         require(source.is_relative_to(root) and driver.freeze(root, check(root, ref), source,
>                         check(root, baseline['worker']), cpu) == baseline, 'native reference geometry, build or resource differs')
>         sources[kind] = {'plan': relative(root, baseline_file), 'seal': relative(root, local_file(run, 'completion.json')),
>                          'report': relative(root, report)}
>         cases.extend({'driver': kind, **case} for case in baseline['cases'] if dataset in (None, case['dataset_id']))
>         terms.extend({'driver': kind, **case} for case in baseline['excluded'] if dataset in (None, case['dataset_id']))
>     require({c['route'] for c in cases} == set(ROUTES) and len(cases) == len({c['case_id'] for c in cases}),
>             'durable plan omits or repeats route cases')
>     body = {'schema': SCHEMA, 'sources': sources, 'source_plan': plan_ref, 'source_run': source_run, 'source_seal': source_seal,
>             'environment': resource.environment(cpu), 'policy': POLICY, 'dataset_projection': dataset, 'cases': cases,
>             'excluded': terms, 'code': {n: digest(local_file(root, n)) for n in CODE}}
>     return {**body, 'plan_content_id': content_id(body)}
>
>
> def _source_plans(root, plan):
>     require(freeze(root, _native_runs(root, plan), plan['environment']['cpu'], plan['dataset_projection']) == plan,
>             'whole-durable plan differs from frozen native and functional references')
>     return {kind: load_json(check(root, b['plan'])) for kind, b in plan['sources'].items()}
>
>
> def _self_paths(folder, wanted):
>     selfstar.verified(folder, wanted)
>     return {n: local_file(folder, n) for n in wanted}
>
>
> def _raw(root, entry, case, work):
>     require(entry['canonical']['object_id'] == case['canonical_object_id'] and entry['file'] == case['source_file'],
>             'durable source does not match frozen case')
>     if case['driver'] == 'abi':
>         return abi.prepare_values(root, entry, case, work)
>     folder = work / 'values'
>     selfstar._stage(root, entry, folder)
>     for col in range(case['cols']):
>         (folder / selfstar.names(col)[1]).write_bytes(selfstar.schema(case['rows'], col))
>     return _self_paths(folder, selfstar.refs(case)[0])
>
>
> def _anchors(base, case):
>     if case['driver'] == 'abi':
>         n = len(list(abi.groups(case['units'])))
>         raw, wire = abi.files(base / 'raw', n), abi.files(base / 'wire', n)
>         _verify_staged(raw, case)
>         return (raw, abi.identities(raw)), (wire, abi.verify_frames(wire, case['units']))
>     a, b = selfstar.refs(case)
>     return (_self_paths(base / 'raw', a), a), (_self_paths(base / 'wire', b), b)
>
>
> def _resolved(run, plan, case, trial, inputs, work):
>     op = trial['operation']
>     begin = monotonic_ns()
>     if case['driver'] == 'abi':
>         out, row = abi.invoke(run, plan, case, trial, inputs, work)
>         if op == 'encode':
>             require(abi.verify_frames(out, case['units']) == row['output'], 'durable ABI frame changed after measurement')
>     else:
>         folder, process, native = selfstar.invoke(run / 'runtime', plan, case, op, inputs, work)
>         expected = selfstar.refs(case)[int(op == 'encode')]
>         out = _self_paths(folder, expected)
>         row = {'case_id': case['case_id'], **trial, 'process': process, 'native': native,
>                'native_totals_ns': selfstar.totals(plan, case, op, native), 'output': expected,
>                'staged_supervision_and_verification_wall_ns': monotonic_ns()-begin}
>     return out, row
>
>
> def _validate(plan, case, t, row, raw, wire, seen):
>     if case['driver'] == 'abi':
>         m, o = (raw, wire) if t['operation'] == 'encode' else (wire, raw)
>         abi.validate(plan, case, t, row, m, o, seen)
>     else:
>         selfstar.validate(plan, case, t, row, seen)
>     require(row['durable_wall_ns'] >= row['staged_supervision_and_verification_wall_ns'] + row['fsync_wall_ns'] and
>             row['fsync_wall_ns'] > 0, 'durable path must include the staged direction and disjoint fsync')
>
>
> def _summarize(case, rows):
>     if case['driver'] == 'abi':
>         result = abi.summarize(case, rows)
>         logical = result['logical_bytes']
>     else:
>         result = selfstar.summarize(case, rows)
>         logical = result['counts']['input_bytes']
>     for op in ('encode', 'decode'):
>         chosen = [r for r in rows if r['phase'] == 'measured' and r['operation'] == op]
>         times = [r['durable_wall_ns'] for r in chosen]
>         result['directions'][op]['verified_durable'] = {'wall_ns': distribution(times),
>                 'fsync_wall_ns': distribution([r['fsync_wall_ns'] for r in chosen]),
>                 'logical_mib_per_second': distribution([logical * 1e9 / (n * (1 << 20)) for n in times])}
>     return result
>
>
> def _recompute(run, plan, baselines):
>     for kind, native in baselines.items():
>         for n, asset in native['runtime']['files'].items():

>     require(env['affinity'] == [plan['environment']['cpu']] and env.keys() == {'affinity', 'before', 'after'},
>             'durable observation environment differs')

>     with local_file(run, 'trials.jsonl').open('rb') as ledger:
>         for case in plan['cases']:
>             kind = case['driver']
>             base = run / kind / 'cases' / case['case_id']
>             (_, raw), (_, wire) = _anchors(base, case)
>             rows = []
>             for i, t in enumerate(baselines[kind]['schedule']):
>                 row = parse_json(ledger.readline(), 'whole-durable ledger row')
>                 op = t['operation']
>                 require(load_json(local_file(base, f'logs/{i}/{op}.stdout')) == row['native'] and
>                         local_file(base, f'logs/{i}/{op}.stderr').stat().st_size == 0, 'durable worker log differs')
>                 _validate(baselines[kind], case, t, row, raw, wire, seen)
>                 rows.append(row)
>             results.append(_summarize(case, rows))
>         require(not ledger.read(1), 'whole-durable ledger has extra observations')
>     return {'schema': SCHEMA + '-report', 'run_id': run.name, 'plan_content_id': plan['plan_content_id'],

>             'environment': env, 'policy': POLICY, 'verified_trials': len(seen),

>

> def _seal(run, plan):

>     v = sub.add_parser('verify')

>     a = parser.parse_args()
>     try:

>             doc = timing.freeze(ROOT, {'abi': a.abi.resolve(strict=True), 'selfstar': a.selfstar.resolve(strict=True)}, a.cpu, a.dataset)
>             a.out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

>     except (ContractError, OSError) as exc:

>
>
> if __name__ == '__main__':

### 本轮完成

- 在 `tsbench` 中通过 **26 项测试和 9 项子测试**。Sprintz、Huff0、SElf* 的隔离预检及通过后的全量已排队，等待 pcodec、Zstd、XZ 固定批计量结束。

### 本轮完成
- 将 CORAD 候选验证扩展到 r40 的 **13 个适用文件、346 个列组、1,174 份留出帧**。全量已启动，记录了 **101/1,174 帧**；继续使用冻结模型、原窗口和原质量门槛，不重新训练或选模。

### 总体进度
**M0–M2 已验收，M3、M4 尚未验收。** PBEPLA-RR 已记录 **377/736 个计划槽**，尚未封账。pcodec、Zstd、XZ 固定批计量及 Sprintz、Huff0、SElf* 耐久计量仍按顺序排队。覆盖清单仍为已复算的 r9。

- 定位了 PBEPLA-RR 的 3 个 Bitcoin 失败窗：首层在原误差门槛下分别需要 **31、40、32 位**栅格分辨率，均超过原生 **30 位**上限。已写入[实施记录](./docs/contracts/m3-real-corpus-plan.md)，未删窗或放宽门槛。
- [CORAD 候选全量](./results/m3-corad-guard-corpus-20261120-r1/full/report.json)已封账。逐帧对账确认：1,174 帧中 **422 帧由拒绝转为通过、656 帧仍拒绝**，产物总字节增加 **35.74%**。仍拒绝的帧中有 537 帧没有任何列引用，说明仅修复列引用不足以满足原质量门槛。独立恢复复算仍在运行。

### 总体进度
**M0–M2 已验收；M3、M4 未验收。** 唯一 r40 主账本不变：828 个决定中 675 通过、45 质量拒绝、4 原生失败、74 域外、30 未触发。M3 仍有 1 项 CORAD 必需义务未通过；ALP AVX512BW 保留原生支持，等待兼容宿主验证。M4 已复算融合、多线程和 opaque 三类成本对照，但不替代 M3 主测，也不授予正式性能资格。

### 本轮完成
- 构建了独立的 PBEPLA-RR 宽栅格候选。原版在 3 个 Bitcoin 窗口均重现 30 位上限错误；候选在**原窗口、原单位、原误差门槛**下，3 个窗口的全部前缀均通过独立批恢复和回调恢复。两种原生编码入口产物一致，ETTh1 对照的旧版帧与 r40 逐字节一致，超出 52 位的反例被拒绝。38 个禁网进程的[预检证据](./results/m3-pbepla-wide-grid-20261120-r4-isolated/report.json)已封账并复算；候选未替换正式插件。
- [CORAD 候选全量](./results/m3-corad-guard-corpus-20261120-r1/full/report.json)与[新版 M3/M4 退出审计](./results/m3-real-r40-20261120/current-exit-audit-20261120-r1.json)均已完成独立复算，结果一致。本轮相关合同测试 **15 通过、1 跳过**。

### 总体进度
**M0–M2 已验收；M3、M4 尚未验收。** r40 主账本未改写。PBEPLA-RR 的栅格上限已有通过定向验证的原生候选，但 NOAA 换输入的精确误差超限是另一个问题。CORAD 候选仍有 **656 帧**质量拒绝，不能视为全量通过。pcodec/Zstd/XZ 固定批已记录 **647/736** 次试验，尚未封账。

### 下一轮任务
1. 验证 PBEPLA-RR 的精确误差边界修正，复跑 NOAA 失败窗，并检查宽栅格候选的全量及旧帧兼容性。
2. 定位 CORAD 无列引用时的稀疏重建误差，保持训练、开发和留出边界及原门槛不变。
3. 跟进固定批及 Sprintz FIRE、Huff0、SElf* 耐久测量；封账复算后再更新覆盖清单，不将诊断结果计作正式性能证据。

> +def sparse_support(frame, rows, columns, width, atoms, maximum):

> +def above_bound(original, restored, bound):

> +    return exceeds

### 本轮完成
- **PBEPLA-RR 精确误差修正通过定向复验。** [禁网复验报告](./results/m3-pbepla-exact-bound-20261120-r1-isolated/report.json)覆盖 3 个 Bitcoin 失败窗、1 个 ETTh1 对照窗和 NOAA 全部 6 个窗口。80 个隔离进程的结果已独立复算：两种原生入口的全部前缀均通过。原 NOAA 失败窗仍能复现；候选经过一次原有数值重试，在不放宽请求门槛的情况下通过，旧解码器也能恢复新帧。
- **固定批全量 736/736 次试验封账并复算。** [覆盖清单 r11](./results/m3-real-r40-20261120/measurement-inventory-20261120-r11.json)确认：r40 的 675 个通过决定全部有完整范围原生重复诊断，其中 583 个也有完整范围的验证后耐久重复。
- **CORAD 无列引用残差归因已全量复算。** [归因报告](./results/m3-corad-guard-corpus-20261120-r1/sparse-residual-full-20261120-r1.json)确认，194,738 个含超限点的稀疏段全部用满非零系数配额；但训练值域内仍有 10,570 个超限点，不能只归因于值域变化，也不能据此断定增加配额就会通过。相关测试 **23 通过、1 跳过**。

### 总体进度
**M0–M2 已验收；M3、M4 尚未验收。** r40 主账本及原判定未改写。PBEPLA-RR 已有同时通过 Bitcoin 和 NOAA 定向复验的候选，尚未覆盖 23 文件全量。CORAD 必需质量义务仍未通过；诊断重复覆盖不等于正式性能准入。

### 下一轮任务
1. 按冻结口径对 PBEPLA-RR 候选执行 **23 文件、20,524 个窗口**的全量验证，核对两种原生入口、全部前缀及旧帧兼容性。
2. 仅用训练集和开发集评估 CORAD 稀疏求解候选；冻结配置后再按原门槛复验留出，并核算完整字节代价。
3. 跟进 Sprintz FIRE、Huff0、SElf* 耐久全量，封账并独立复算后再更新覆盖清单和退出审计。

>     def invoke(self,lane,mode,inputs,layer=None):

>         expected_in = {k:identity(v) for k,v in inputs.items()}
>         prefix = {'lane':lane,'mode':mode,'layer':layer}
>         outputs = {}
>         if self.saved is None:

>                 files = {}
>                 for n,raw in inputs.items():

>                     p.write_bytes(raw)
>                     files[n] = p
>                 dest,rows = call(self.run/lane,self.lock['closures'][lane],work/'step',mode,files,layer)
>                 state = load_json(local_file(work/'step','process.json'))
>                 for p in sorted(dest.iterdir()):
>                     wire = local_file(dest,p.name).read_bytes()
>                     meta = identity(wire)
>                     key = (meta['bytes'],meta['sha256'])
>                     if key not in self.cache:
>                         self.cache[key] = {'offset':self.pack.tell(),**meta}
>                         self.pack.write(wire)
>                     outputs[p.name] = wire
>                 out_refs = {n:self.cache[(len(raw),identity(raw)['sha256'])] for n,raw in outputs.items()}
>         else:
>             ob = self.saved[self.index]
>             require(all(ob[k]==v for k,v in prefix.items()), 'candidate operation order differs')
>             state,rows,out_refs = (ob[k] for k in ('process','native','products'))
>             for n,meta in sorted(out_refs.items()):
>                 offset = meta['offset']
>                 if offset not in self.cache:
>                     require(self.pack.tell()==offset and 0<meta['bytes']<=131072,'invalid/gapped candidate product reference')
>                     self.cache[offset] = self.pack.read(meta['bytes'])
>                 outputs[n] = self.cache[offset]

>             require(state['session_id'] not in self.seen,'candidate reused an isolated process')
>             self.seen.add(state['session_id'])
>         require(state['status']=='completed' and state['returncode']==0 and state['operation']==mode and
>                 state['pid'] and state['session_id'] and state['input_mounts']==expected_in and
>                 [r['index'] for r in rows]==[int(n.split('-')[0]) for n in sequence], 'candidate operation input or terminal differs')
>         wanted = set()
>         for n,r in zip(sequence,rows,strict=True):
>             if r['status']=='failed':
>                 require(bool(r['reason']), 'candidate failure lacks a reason')
>             elif layer is None:
>                 require(r['status']=='encoded' and r['rows']*8==len(inputs[n]), 'candidate encode extent differs')
>                 wanted.update(f'{n}-{k}' for k in LAYERS)
>                 if mode=='replay':
>                     require(r['replay']['same_bytes_as_batch'], 'native replay did not match its serialized control')
>             else:
>                 require(r['status']=='restored' and r['layer']==layer, 'candidate restore did not consume detached prefix')
>                 wanted.add(n)
>         require(wanted==set(outputs), 'candidate native process returned unexpected products')
>         self.calls.append({**prefix,'process':state,'native':rows,'products':out_refs})
>         self.index += 1
>         return outputs,{n:r for n,r in zip(sequence,rows,strict=True)}

>  [宽栅格＋精确误差候选](../../catalog/selections/pbepla-wide-grid-exact-bound-candidate-v1.json) 使用独立构建身份，在两个原生编码入口及其序列化复验中补上 binary64 误差边界判断：只在舍入后误差与门槛相等时计算精确差的舍入残量，从而区分精确相等和实际略超限；不改原请求门槛或重试规则。[禁网复验](../../results/m3-pbepla-exact-bound-20261120-r1-isolated/report.json) 的 80 个进程覆盖原 4 个窗口及 NOAA 的全部 6 个 PBEPLA 窗口，双原生入口、全部前缀均通过，封账已独立复算。原 NOAA 失败窗仍复现旧帧的 `9007199254740993/562949953421312 > 16`；候选在一次原有数值收缩重试后以有效门槛 `15.984` 编码，实际最大误差为 `8998192055486251/562949953421312`，旧版解码器也能恢复该 PBEP v1 新帧。其余 5 个 NOAA 已通过窗和 ETTh1 对照的三个前缀字节不变。该版本只消除定向失败，不替换正式注册或 NOAA 原日志；尚需按 23 文件原生分母复核新版本。
> +
> +[候选真实语料执行器](../../tools/m3_pbepla_candidate_corpus.py) 按 r40 的两条原生路线冻结 **23 文件、20,524 个窗口**，绑定同一旧帧全集、宽栅格＋精确误差构建及 NOAA 预检。每个窗口分别调用原生渐进、replay 编码，全部前缀以对应的原生批／回调模式独立恢复并复算原单位精确误差。旧帧未变时核对历史摘要；改变时实际交叉恢复 v1，或核对旧解码器拒绝 v2。每次候选验证仅一份完整账本和一个顺序打包产物，不分片签收；最多 32 窗分组，组内相同字节只存一次。先用 ETTh1 全部 35 窗预检，成功后同入口执行全量；只有全量封账并独立重读原件、产物及所有挂载记录后发布统计。不吸收为正式 r40 或性能证据。
> @@
>  [无引用帧的全量残差归因](../../results/m3-corad-guard-corpus-20261120-r1/sparse-residual-full-20261120-r1.json) 在 1,174 帧分母中独立解释 978 帧（441 通过、537 质量拒绝），另列 196 帧不在无引用分析范围内。按冻结窗重新取原件、重建并核对源与恢复摘要；点误差从原始 binary64 值判定，舍入相等时用有理数精确比较。共 713,688 个值超逐点门槛，其中 703,118 个落在相应训练列的最小值/最大值之外，仍有 10,570 个落在训练范围之内；194,738 个包含超限点的稀疏段全用了档案声明的最大非零系数数目。原生 raw 尾段逐位恢复。非零项用满和范围外分布是诊断观察，不是已证明的因果关系，不说明放宽非零限额可通过。若评估额外的稀疏求解策略，只能在 train/development 上确定并冻结，留出不可用于选参；之后按原门槛独立复验、计入完整字节成本。
> +
> +[原生 CORAD 开发集对照](../../tools/m3_corad_sparse_development.py) 预先锁定 OMP 非零项预算 `2 / 3 / 4`。保留已冻结的两种训练产物、字典、4 点段、相关阈值和原质量门槛，只改变调用原生公开接口时传入的求解预算，不为算法新增补偿流。执行器只解析现有 train/development 前缀并核对分区摘要，编码进程仅挂冻结模型及开发窗，独立解码进程仅挂帧；原 C 解码结果与独立解释器一致才逐列判定。全量开发中，只有所有计划窗均通过的预算有资格入选，再按完整 CRD1 字节最少、同数时取较低预算决定是否冻结候选。ETTh1 投影不选参；开发集产物不能替代留出证据或正式计量。

### 本轮完成
- **PBEPLA-RR 候选版全量验证通过。** [报告](./results/m3-pbepla-exact-corpus-20261120-r1/full/report.json)已封账并独立复算。原生渐进和 replay 两条路线各通过 **23 个文件、20,524 个窗口**，修复了原先失败的 3 个 Bitcoin 窗口；61,563 个旧版前缀的帧和恢复字节保持不变。未替换正式注册。
- **补齐 r40 的重复计量诊断。** [r12 覆盖清单](./results/m3-real-r40-20261120/measurement-inventory-20261120-r12.json)已独立复算，675 个通过决定均有完整范围的原生重复和验证后耐久重复。已生成[退出审计 r2](./results/m3-real-r40-20261120/current-exit-audit-20261120-r2.json)，二次复算仍在运行。这些诊断不替代正式主测。
- **修正 CORAD 开发集验证工具。** ETTh1 的 6 项试验均成功恢复并复算：预算 2 的两项质量不达标，预算 3、4 各通过两项。后续发现部分帧超过旧控制器的 256 KiB 输入缓冲，已构建 512 KiB 版本，原生解码库不变。新版禁网复验已排队；相关合同测试 **23 项通过**。

### 总体进度
**M0–M2 已验收，M3–M6 未验收。** 正式 r40 主账本未改：828 个决定中，675 通过、45 质量拒绝、4 原生失败、74 域外、30 条件未触发。180 项必需义务仍缺 1 项 CORAD 留出质量通过；ALP AVX512BW 保留原生支持，待兼容宿主验证。M5 的 204 展示格和 264 原子关系尚无正式资格。

### 下一轮任务
1. 收齐 CORAD 复验与退出审计复算结果。只有在全部开发窗通过的预算才进入留出验证，不用留出数据选参。
2. 将 PBEPLA-RR 修复以独立构建身份接入下一版冻结计划，复验同入口换输入；继续把正式双向计量接入同一全量运行和主账本，不拼接 r40 的诊断结果。

> """The explicit wide-grid route accepts only canonical, nested PBEP prefixes."""
> from struct import pack
> from zlib import crc32
>
> import pytest

> from tsbench.application.m3_pbepla_repair import assess

>
>
> def make(layer, *, version=2, width=32, payload=None):
>     # Span / (2 * eps[0]) is 2**32. The residual grids need 3 bits each.
>     body = b'abc'[:layer] if payload is None else payload
>     h = (HEADER.pack(b'PBEP',version,1,3,layer,1,64,0,32*2**32) + pack('<3d',*EPS) + bytes([width,3,3]) +
>          pack(f'<{layer}Q',*[8]*layer) + pack('<I',crc32(body)))
>     return h + pack('<I',crc32(h)) + body
>
>
> def test_wide_grid_has_canonical_version_and_rejects_crc_or_resolution_changes():

### 本轮完成
- **PBEPLA-RR 修复版已接入 M3 公共入口。** [新版冻结计划](./results/m3-pbepla-entry-20261120-r4/plan.json)单独锁定修复构建，原 Unique 构建和 r40 主账本不变。原先失败的 3 个 Bitcoin 窗口，在原生渐进和 replay 两条路线均逐层恢复通过。[NOAA 换输入审计](./results/m3-pbepla-entry-20261120-r4/noaa-audit.json)覆盖全部 12 项选型：33 个适用决定全部通过，另有 1 个域外、2 个条件未触发；二次复算仍在运行。
- **CORAD 开发集对照已封账并独立复算。** [全量报告](./results/m3-corad-sparse-development-20261120-r5/full/report.json)覆盖 13 个文件。预算 2、3、4 各验证 1,176 项，分别通过 535、705、1,052 项。扩大控制器缓冲后没有原生编解码失败，但没有一个预算通过全部质量门槛，因此**未选参、未运行留出**。
- r40 旧计划仍可验证，退出审计 r2 复算一致；相关合同测试 **21 通过、1 跳过**。

### 总体进度
**M0–M2 已验收，M3–M6 未验收。** r40 正式主账本仍为 828 个决定：675 通过、45 质量拒绝、4 原生失败、74 域外、30 条件未触发。PBEPLA-RR 的修复已有新版公共入口证据，但不回写 r40。M3 仍缺 CORAD 必需留出质量结果和同一全量运行的正式双向计量；ALP AVX512BW 保留原生支持，待兼容宿主验证。M5 的 204 展示格与 264 原子关系尚无正式资格。

### 下一轮任务
1. 从 CORAD 预算 4 仍拒绝的 124 个开发窗定位剩余误差，评估原生数值修复；不放宽门槛，不用留出数据选参。
2. 将双向重复计量接入新版 M3 的同一冻结计划、同一次运行和同一主账本；不拼接 r40 的诊断结果。

### 本轮完成
- 将 pcodec 两条固定批路线、XZ 和 Zstd 固定批的双向计量接入 M3 功能主账本。新版计划的计量适配范围从 **46 增至 138 个决定**，仍有 586 个适用决定缺适配器。[ETTh1 预检](./results/m3-in-run-fixed-batch-20261120-r1/etth1-audit.json)中，固定批和 PBEPLA 共 6 条路线、64 个方向试验全部通过并独立复算；未引用 r40 的计时数据。相关合同测试 11 项通过。
- 独立复算并重放了 [CORAD 三路线回归](./results/m3-pbepla-corad-entry-20261120-r1/corad-audit.json)。39 个适用决定中，仅 `national-illness` 的 3 条路线通过，其余 36 个仍被原质量门槛拒绝。17 个命名义务中 11 个通过、6 个失败：冻结的推理专项样本不再同时覆盖稀疏和引用分支，预声明质量门槛义务仍未通过。

### 总体进度
**M0–M2 已验收，M3–M6 未验收。** r40 功能主账本保持原样：828 个决定中，675 通过、45 质量拒绝、4 原生失败、74 域外、30 条件未触发。新版计量仍是非独占预检，不授予正式性能资格；M5 的 204 个展示格和 264 个原子关系尚未取得正式资格。

### 下一轮任务
把 ALP 两条路线和 Titchy 原生批处理接入同一主账本的双向计量；为 CORAD 专项补上预先冻结的安全引用正例和拒绝反例，不改质量门槛或已有判定。继续补齐其余路线与独占环境验证，再启动新版 36 路全量和换输入复验。

### 本轮完成
- 按 M0 合同变更流程冻结了 [CORAD 修订](./results/m0-corad-guard-amendment-20261120-r1/amendment.json)，将真实留出质量与引用机制正反例分别验证，不改变模型、输入或质量门槛。[新版公共入口独立审计](./results/m3-corad-amendment-20261120-r1/corad-audit.json)确认：**17 项命名义务全部通过**，错误的自引用被原生解码器拒绝且无输出。原语料仍有 **36 个质量拒绝**，没有改判。
- 完成同构建的 [NOAA 换输入复验](./results/m3-corad-amendment-20261120-r1/noaa-audit.json)并独立复算：36 个决定中 33 通过、1 域外、2 条件未触发，12 个首批选型均有通过证据。相关合同测试 9 项通过。

### 总体进度

### 本轮完成
- 确认 Gorilla 与 Unique 基线选型一致：`tv-batch` 使用原版 C11 `gorilla_c`，`append-resume` 和 `iterator` 使用同源 C11 状态修复构建。`.cpp` 文件是 TSBench 的适配和控制层，不是算法实现。
- 在 `tsbench` 中用 ETTh1 和 National Illness 完成三条路线的[隔离预检与独立复算](./results/m3-in-run-gorilla-20261120-r1/etth1-and-national-illness-audit.json)：6 个文件—路线决定通过，56 次方向试验全部核对一致（14 次预热、42 次测量），覆盖两种尾块长度。12 项合同测试通过，旧版计量审计仍可复算。
- 已更新[项目目标](./TSDataCompressBenchMark目标.md)和[M3 合同](./docs/contracts/m3-real-corpus-plan.md)。首次外层沙箱失败的账本未被覆盖；该次失败的原生日志随临时目录回收，需修复留存机制。

### 总体进度
- **M0、M1、M2 已验收；M3、M4、M5、M6 未验收。** M5 的 204 个展示格和 264 项原子关系尚无正式资格。
- M3 同一主账本计量已接入 **255/724** 个适用决定，还差 **469** 个；Gorilla 新增的 48 个是**计划已接入**，不是全量实测通过。历史 r40 的 828 个决定保持不变：675 通过、45 质量拒绝、4 原生失败、74 域外、30 条件未触发。ALP 保留 AVX512BW 原生支持，仍待支持硬件实测。

### 下一轮任务
先修复 Gorilla 失败日志留存，保留旧计划及账本；再复用已有原生控制器，将 pcodec 两条页路线接入主账本，同步核验正式主测所需的系统级独占条件。

### 本轮完成
- 将 pcodec 的 `source-pages` 和 `native-pages` 接入 M3 主账本，复用现有原生库和隔离控制器，新增 **46 个可计量的文件—路线决定**。
- 在 `tsbench` 中用 ETTh1、ETTm1 完成[定向预检与独立复算](./results/m3-in-run-pcodec-pages-20261120-r1/etth1-and-ettm1-audit.json)：pcodec 32 次、Gorilla `append-resume` 24 次方向试验通过，覆盖 pcodec 跨 65,536 行边界后的尾组。15 项合同测试通过。
- 修复 Gorilla 和 pcodec 页路线的失败日志留存。[失败对照](./results/m3-in-run-pcodec-pages-20261120-r1/retained-failure-audit.json)确认 3 次隔离启动失败的 stderr 均可核验，28 个未执行的方向槽未计入测量。

- 历史 r40 主账本保持不变：675 通过、45 质量拒绝、4 原生失败、74 域外、30 条件未触发。本机尚未证实系统级独占，预检不授正式性能资格；M5 的 204 个展示格和 264 项原子关系也尚无正式资格。

### 本轮完成
- 将 Sprintz `fire-batch`、Huff0 `huff0-reference`、SElf* 批处理和原生增量四条路线接入 M3 主账本，新增 **92 个适用决定**。SElf* 增量保留原生状态操作，不当作批处理计量。
- 在 `tsbench` 中完成 [ETTh1 隔离预检与独立复算](./results/m3-in-run-whole-20261120-r2/etth1-audit.json)：4 个决定、32 次独立方向试验通过（8 次预热、24 次测量）。17 项合同测试通过，第五版审计仍可复算。

### 总体进度
- 以更新后的 **724 个 M3 主账本适用决定**为目标，[第六版计划](./results/m3-in-run-whole-20261120-r2/plan.json)已接入 **393/724**，还差 **331 个**。这是计量适配覆盖，不是全量实测通过数。
- **M0–M2 已验收，M3–M6 未验收。** 历史账本未改写；本机仍未证实系统级独占，定向预检不授正式性能资格。

### 下一轮任务
先接入 ZFP 的 **92 个决定**：三条可逆场路线保留串行与 OpenMP 配置的独立观测，定率数组单列修改、重开与质量拒绝。随后继续补齐其余 **239 个决定**，最终用一份冻结计划、一次运行和一本主账本复算全部 724 个适用决定，不拼接预检结果。

> -### 正式主测的资源证据边界
> +第七版 `--measurement-zfp FIELD OBSERVER ARRAY --measurement-zfp-cpus CPU1 CPU2` 将 ZFP 的 `field-baseline`、`field-modes`、`openmp-encode`、`fixed-rate-array` 接入主账本，每路 23 个适用决定。[冻结计划](../../results/m3-in-run-zfp-20261120-r1/plan.json)达到 485/724 个已接计量，剩余 239 个。复用 Unique 冻结本机库及已有文件隔离控制器；可逆场按当前功能行验证全列原始位、逐帧字节，并为串行、OpenMP 1 和 OpenMP 2 使用一致的双物理核预算。线程参与情况来自独立同工作量观察进程，不把插桩结果混入主时钟。定率数组按旧合同的平衡窗记录原生修改、初始和更新状态分别重开；质量拒绝仍单列诊断时钟，不能作为通过样本，也不把窗口当成整列恢复。

### 本轮完成
- 将 ZFP 三条可逆场路线和一条定率数组路线接入 M3 主账本，新增 **92 个适用决定**。串行与 OpenMP 配置使用相同的双物理核预算；实际线程参与由独立进程观察，不混入计时样本。
- 在 `tsbench` 中完成 [ETTh1 与 Bitcoin 1 的隔离预检及独立复算](./results/m3-in-run-zfp-20261120-r1/zfp-preflight-audit.json)：8 个决定、104 次方向试验、12 次独立线程观察。7 个决定通过；Bitcoin 1 定率数组的质量拒绝保留，其计时仅作诊断。20 项合同测试通过。

### 总体进度
[第七版冻结计划](./results/m3-in-run-zfp-20261120-r1/plan.json)已接入 **485/724** 个适用决定，剩余 **239** 个。这是计量适配覆盖，不是全量实测通过数。**M0–M2 已验收，M3–M6 未验收**；定向预检不授正式性能资格。

### 下一轮任务
优先接入 Titchy 的原生包流、加载后访问和无状态范围读取，共 **69 个决定**，分别核验各自的操作边界和成本。其余路线补齐后，用一份冻结计划、一次运行和一本主账本核对全部 724 个适用决定，不拼接预检结果。

**本轮完成：** Titchy 的 6 个决定、48 次隔离试验已封账并独立复算。第九版新增 Zstd 字典路线的 23 个决定，将训练、留出编码和独立恢复分别计量；[ETTh1 与 Economics-17 预检](./results/m3-in-run-zstd-dictionary-20261120-r3/preflight-measurement-audit.json)的 24 次隔离试验全部通过并复算一致。已更新项目目标文档和 M3 合同。

**总体进度：** M3 主账本计量已接入 **577/724** 个适用决定，剩余 **147** 个。接入与定向预检不等于正式全量实测；M0–M2 已验收，M3–M6 尚未验收。

**下一轮任务：** 优先接入 Zstd/XZ 的 **62** 个原生会话与 worker 决定，分别记录首输出、完整编解码和实际 worker 线程数。其余待接为 CORAD **39** 个、Sprintz 查询 **23** 个、Huff0 共享表 **23** 个。

**本轮完成**：为 CORAD 的 13 个推理决定接入了原件读取到编码产物验证、同步的独立计时，并冻结了 [v14 计划](./results/m3-in-run-corad-raw-encode-20261120-r1/plan.json)。ETTh1、Weather 从原件重新提取的留出数据与冻结输入逐字节一致；51 项测试通过，v13 和 v14 计划均通过校验。v14 尚未实跑，训练和仅帧恢复的计时边界不变。

**总体进度**：M0–M2 已验收。[v13 全量诊断](./results/m3-primary-full-v13-20261120-r1/6676d9e3459b40f993fa5351cdfaa351/ledger.jsonl)仍在同一次运行中推进，截至本轮检查，**97/724 个适用决定已完成计量并通过验证**，尚未封账。M3、M4 新版均未验收，本次诊断不授正式性能资格。

**下一轮任务**：继续跟踪 v13，不重启、不拼接结果。封账后复算全部 828 个语料决定和 186 项专项义务，并核对 M4 三类剖析与实际主账本的输入、帧、恢复和后端。待计量资源空闲后，单独跑 v14 禁网预检，验证新增编码时钟。

> #!/usr/bin/env python3
> """Spot-check already written M3 measurements without sealing or modifying a live run."""
> from argparse import ArgumentParser
> from hashlib import sha256
> from os import fstat
> from pathlib import Path
> import sys
>
> from audit_m3_in_run_measurement import ROOT, _audit_row, _directories
> from tsbench.application.m3_real_corpus_execution import _entry_map
> from tsbench.assets import content_id, load_json, local_file, parse_json, require
>
> COORDINATES = ('work_item_id','dataset_id','selection','route','operation','applicability')
>
>
> def _read_prefix(stream, items, wanted):
>     limit = fstat(stream.fileno()).st_size
>     prefix = sha256()
>     picked, committed = [], 0
>     for i, item in enumerate(items):
>         remaining = limit - stream.tell()
>         if not remaining:
>             break
>         line = stream.readline(remaining)
>         if not line.endswith(b'\n'):
>             require(stream.tell() == limit, 'M3 ledger shrank or changed during the observation')
>             break  # The one writer may be in the middle of appending this line.
>         row = parse_json(line, f'M3 live ledger line {i+1}')
>         require(not row.get('entry_kind') and all(row.get(k) == item[k] for k in COORDINATES),
>                 'M3 live ledger is not an ordered prefix of the supplied unfiltered plan')
>         prefix.update(line)
>         committed += 1
>         if (item['dataset_id'],item['route']) in wanted:
>             picked.append((item,row))
>     return committed, stream.tell(), prefix.hexdigest(), picked
>
>
> def check(root, plan, run, picks):
>     require(not (run/'completion.json').exists(), 'sealed run must use the full M3 audit')
>     require(plan['plan_content_id'] == content_id({k:v for k,v in plan.items() if k!='plan_content_id'}),
>             'M3 live ledger candidate plan identity differs')
>     known = {(i['dataset_id'],i['route']) for i in plan['work_items']}
>     require(picks and len(picks) <= 4 and picks <= known, 'choose 1 to 4 known dataset/route pairs')
>     with local_file(run,'ledger.jsonl').open('rb') as stream:
>         count, read_bytes, prefix, picked = _read_prefix(stream, plan['work_items'], picks)
>     matches = {(i['dataset_id'],i['route']) for i,_ in picked}
>     require(matches == picks and len(picked) == len(picks), 'a selected spot-check is not present in the complete-line prefix')
>     sessions = set()
>     routes, _ = _directories(plan['measurement']['schema'])
>     entries = _entry_map(root,load_json(local_file(root,plan['definition']['plan']['path'])))
>     checked = []
>     for item,row in picked:
>         detail, _ = _audit_row(root,plan,run,entries,routes,item,row,sessions)
>         checked.append({k:v for k,v in detail.items() if k!='summary'})
>     return {'schema':'bmk.m3-live-spot-check/1','scope':'ordered_complete_line_prefix_and_selected_measurement_records_not_a_seal',
>             'run_id':run.name,'candidate_plan_id':plan['plan_content_id'],'complete_corpus_lines_observed':count,
>             'prefix_sha256':prefix,'ledger_bytes_read':read_bytes,'measurements_recomputed':checked,
>             'group_processes_verified':len(sessions),'source_bound_to_plan_by_seal':False,
>             'timing_admitted':False,'stage_accepted':False,'qualification_granted':False}
>
>
> def main():
>     import json
>     p = ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
>     p.add_argument('--plan',type=Path,required=True)
>     p.add_argument('--run',type=Path,required=True)
>     p.add_argument('--pick',action='append',nargs=2,metavar=('DATASET','ROUTE'),required=True)
>     a = p.parse_args()
>     try:
>         require(len(a.pick)==len({tuple(x) for x in a.pick}), 'duplicate spot-check coordinate')
>         print(json.dumps(check(ROOT,load_json(a.plan),a.run.resolve(strict=True),{tuple(x) for x in a.pick}),ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
>     except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
>         p.exit(1,f'{exc}\n')
>
>
> if __name__=='__main__':
>     main()

### 本轮完成
- 新增 [M3 留样复解覆盖审计工具](./tools/audit_m3_primary_retained_replay.py)。它按同一运行封印、文件路径、长度和 SHA-256 汇总复解证据，拒绝跨运行混用，并列出仍未复解的留样。
- 用 r40 的 8 份直接复解报告回归核对，工具识别出的 **928 份留样**与旧审计逐文件一致。此结果不计入 v13。`tsbench` 中 **32 项相关测试通过**。未修改 v13 的计划、构建或运行目录。

### 总体进度
- **M0–M2** 已按新版合同验收。**M3** 的 [v13 全量诊断](./results/m3-primary-full-v13-20261120-r1/6676d9e3459b40f993fa5351cdfaa351/ledger.jsonl)仍在运行：**166/724** 个适用决定已计量并验证通过，**558** 个尚未落账；另已登记 **23** 个域外决定。已落账项未发现功能或计量失败，但尚未封账，也未取得正式性能资格。
- **M4** 待绑定新版主账本的三类剖析证据，尚未验收。**M5–M6** 尚未验收；204 个展示格、264 项原子关系尚未执行正式资格验证。

### 下一轮任务
- 继续跟踪同一 v13 运行。封账后先复算全部决定和专项义务，再核对留样复解覆盖，并绑定 M4 的 ALP 融合、Weather Zstd 多线程和 XZ opaque 证据。计量资源空闲后，再执行 v14 的 CORAD 禁网端到端编码预检。

> # 整个匹配轮的干扰分类与重试合同（实现组件，尚未接入全量）
>
> 对应设计 §8.12、§8.13、§12.6。`tsbench.supervisor.matched_round_retry` 服务于**每槽每次尝试均新建进程**的匹配轮。它不是宿主租约、系统独占或计量准入。v13/v14 已冻结的诊断不符合这个合同，不能补填字段、回写账本或据此重新分类。
>
> 1. 计时前由上层冻结匹配范围、已随机化的全轮顺序、各 slot 的逻辑 CPU 预算、预期 governor 和重试次数上限。`policy_id` 覆盖这些内容。这里不修改 governor 和亲和性；上层须另记录实际宿主配置、隔离与预留证据。
> 2. 每个 terminal 记录保留实际会话身份和环境证据。启动前后 governor、worker 有效亲和性和实际观测到的 CPU 都有专用位置；不适用或观测不到保留 `null` 或缺失的单 CPU 值。看到的 CPU 子集不证明运行期间没发生短暂迁移；集内迁移不叫预算越界。负载、IRQ、NUMA 和散热并不由这些信号保证。
> 3. 只在观测到 governor 不符、worker 亲和性违反冻结预算或实际在预算外 CPU 执行时，可将全轮标为干扰并在上限内重跑。保留原 attempt 和原终态，重跑全轮的所有方法及方向，沿用冻结顺序和 slot ID，换新 attempt 与会话。超时、崩溃、校准不足、质量拒绝或慢样本本身都不是干扰证据。缺测不等于干净，也不是重跑理由。
> 4. 复算报告分列首轮和末轮验证数、各轮环境状态和可能的候选轮；候选必须是同一轮所有 slot 通过且所需信号齐全，禁止按方法拼接各轮。即使存在候选，也仍需上层证明资源、原始时钟、功能和质量资格。
> 5. 接入生产执行器时，实际环境观测必须来自监督器和实际工作进程，关联真实会话；不能用计划中的 CPU 集合回填。原始记录与派生轮终态由单写者按阶段合同持久化。若执行器中断，只能报告已发布的原始记录，不得补造完整 attempt。本组件的回调不代替持久化、恢复或宿主独占。

> #ifndef TSBENCH_MEASUREMENT_WORKER_ENVIRONMENT_HPP
> #define TSBENCH_MEASUREMENT_WORKER_ENVIRONMENT_HPP
>
> // Endpoint evidence from the calling worker thread, outside the codec clock.
> // Linux GNU sched_* APIs, not continuous tracking or per-thread accounting.
> #include <cerrno>
> #include <cstddef>
> #include <optional>
> #include <ostream>
> #include <vector>
> #include <sched.h>
> #include <sys/syscall.h>
> #include <unistd.h>
>
> namespace tsbench::measurement {
>
> struct WorkerCheckpoint {
>     long namespace_pid;
>     long namespace_tid;
>     int cpu;
>     std::optional<std::vector<int>> affinity;
> };
>
> inline std::optional<std::vector<int>> worker_affinity() {
>     // Retry only the undersized-mask error; larger Linux CPU index spaces
>     // cannot be represented by a fixed CPU_SETSIZE stack allocation.
>     for (int limit = CPU_SETSIZE; limit <= 131072; limit *= 2) {
>         const auto bytes = CPU_ALLOC_SIZE(limit);
>         cpu_set_t* mask = CPU_ALLOC(limit);
>         if (mask == nullptr) return std::nullopt;
>         CPU_ZERO_S(bytes, mask);
>         const int rc = sched_getaffinity(0, bytes, mask);
>         const int err = errno;
>         if (rc != 0) {
>             CPU_FREE(mask);
>             if (err == EINVAL) continue;
>             return std::nullopt;
>         }
>         std::vector<int> ids;
>         try {
>             for (int cpu = 0; cpu < limit; ++cpu) {
>                 if (CPU_ISSET_S(cpu, bytes, mask)) ids.push_back(cpu);
>             }
>         } catch (...) {
>             CPU_FREE(mask);
>             throw;
>         }
>         CPU_FREE(mask);
>         if (!ids.empty()) return ids;
>         return std::nullopt;
>     }
>     return std::nullopt;
> }
>
> inline WorkerCheckpoint worker_checkpoint() {
>     return {getpid(), syscall(SYS_gettid), sched_getcpu(), worker_affinity()};
> }
>
> inline void write_worker_checkpoint(std::ostream& stream, const WorkerCheckpoint& record) {
>     stream << "{\"namespace_pid\":" << record.namespace_pid << ",\"namespace_tid\":" << record.namespace_tid << ",\"cpu\":";
>     if (record.cpu >= 0) stream << record.cpu;
>     else stream << "null";
>     stream << ",\"affinity\":";
>     if (!record.affinity) {
>         stream << "null";
>     } else {
>         stream << '[';
>         for (std::size_t i = 0; i < record.affinity->size(); ++i) {
>             if (i) stream << ',';
>             stream << (*record.affinity)[i];
>         }
>         stream << ']';
>     }
>     stream << '}';
> }
>
> }  // namespace tsbench::measurement
